publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Optimizing security dynamic scheduling method in cloud storage is significant for improving resource date throughput and storage space of a cloud storage system. The paper presents a self-adaptive layered sleep vision-based method for security dynamic scheduling in cloud storage. A decision-making tree model is used for feature classification of cloud storage resources scheduling, top-down analytical method is used for multithread space reconstruction of resources in cloud storage, and self-adaptive filtering algorithm is used to remove redundant resources. The method of adaptive layered sleep vision is introduced to complete scheduling of cloud storage resources and to improve efficiency of resource scheduling. It is indicated by the simulation result that security and dynamic scheduling in cloud storage with the improved method improves accuracy and efficiency of security resources scheduling in cloud storage, showing relatively high resource utilization.

articleTitle: A Novel Method to Analyze Accuracy of Target Measurement Based on Entropy
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In radar tracking, the relationship between target motion and radar measurement is nonlinear, which is described by conversion function from polar to Cartesian coordinate. In this paper, based on information entropy, a new method is presented to measure the amount of target Cartesian position information acquired from radar polar coordinate. Furthermore, by applying linear approximation and without approximation of the nonlinear conversion function, the factors affecting the accuracy of target position obtained from radar polar measurement are analyzed based on the proposed entropy. With the proposed analysis method, it is proved that with the increase of measurement precision and the decrease of radial range, the target position accuracy acquired from radar polar measurements increases, and it is independent of the target bearing.

articleTitle: Functional Safety Analysis for the Design of VCU Used in Pure Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Vehicle control unit (VCU) is the processing center of pure electric vehicle. With the increase of application, the safety design becomes the essential issue for VCU. According to the requirement of ISO 26262, VCU needed to be designed at least with ASIL C. The derivation of functional safety requirement for VCU poses a great challenge. In order to address the issue, this paper puts forward the technology of functional safety analysis, and designs the three layer architecture. The functional safety requirements are then derived for the architecture of VCU hardware and software.

articleTitle: Slice Interpolation in MRI Using a Decomposition-Reconstruction Method
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The algebraically demanding interpolation needs the signal values to be precise at the interpolate point. But for MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging), the intensive values of given scene are for voxel, other than points. So the results of algebraically demanding interpolation are coarse in MRI. Since MRI corresponds to a thin slice through human body, it contains all information in the slice. The proposed algorithm decomposes firstly the information from the pixels in MRI, and then reconstructs them under the rule of organ consistency and exclusive to get higher slice-resolution. Both the theory analysis and experiment results proved the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. Results show that the proposed algorithm outperforms the other interpolation methods, which means that the D-R (Decomposition-reconstruction) method is more suitable for MRI interpolation.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Algorithm Based on Reverse Co-Salient Regions (RCSR) Features
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To solve the problems of absence of expression-correlation in single-image-based expression recognition, and limitation of one classifier, a novel facial expression recognition method based on reverse co-saliency region features is proposed in this paper. Firstly, seven different classifications of expression images of a same person are used to extract facial changed regions of different expressions by a reverse co-saliency features method, named Reverse Co-Salient Regions (RCSR). Secondly, the extracted salient regions are described as texture and shape features LBP and HOG. Finally, based on RCSR features, multi-classifiers decision mechanism is used for expressions recognition. The following experimental results show that the recognition accuracy increases obviously compared with 3 different kinds of single-image-based expression recognition methods.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Correlation between Internet Public Opinion and Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Previous studies have shown that changes in human emotions or public opinions can have an impact on volatility of stock market. In this paper, we make use of the unstructured comments data from the stock forum on the Shanghai Composite Index to generate the structural emotion time series of the stock market based on a series of methods including word segmentation, feature extraction, machine learning and modeling techniques. Then, we analyze the relationship between the stock price changes and the emotional index. From the results, it can be seen that stock emotional index has strong interaction with volatility of stock market. Therefore, the emotion index changes may be used as a tool for future stock market trend prediction.

articleTitle: Consensus Tracking of Nonlinear Second-Order Multi-Agent Systems with External Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the leader-follower consensus problem of multi-agent systems governed by second order dynamics with nonlinear terms. Taking into account the external disturbances, a leader-follower consensus tracking algorithm for each agent with high-order sliding mode control method is proposed to make all the followers track the leader. Then we prove that each agent can follow the leader under the proposed tracking strategy by using graph theory and Lyapunov approach. Finally, a simulation is given to illustrate the effectiveness of proposed theoretical results.

articleTitle: Influence of Power System Operation Mode on Wind Power Acceptance
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In-grid wind power has been a challenging problem in power system due to its high volatility and low efficiency. The wind power acceptance must be first considered before a wind farm is planned to be built. There are many factors effecting wind power acceptance, such as wind turbine type, PCC load capacity, regional load characteristics, etc. A large amount of research show that wind farms have significant influence on the local grid voltage level, so the primary factor of wind power acceptance is voltage normally. In the study, the impact of power system operation mode on wind power acceptance is discussed by analyzing the voltage variation. The combination of power flow calculation and engineering method is utilized to evaluate the wind power acceptance. The power flow and engineering calculation indicate that higher supply voltage and lower load lead to higher acceptance of wind power.

articleTitle: A Non-Sense Authentication Scheme of WLAN Based on RSSI Location Fingerprint
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: WLAN often adopts the user ID and password to judge the legitimacy of users, but the hacker can illegally access the WLAN by sniffing the legal user's ID and password. To solve this problem, a novel authentication scheme is introduced. The scheme makes good use of the user's MAC address and RSSI location fingerprint as authentication information to control the user to access the WLAN. The legal user can directly access the WLAN without inputting the user ID and password, and the hacker is very difficult to forge the RSSI location fingerprint to access the WLAN. Through testing in IEEE802.11g, the authentication scheme has the advantages of strong anti-jamming capability and high authentication success rate.

articleTitle: Electrocardiograph (ECG) Recognition Based on Graphical Fusion with Geometric Algebra
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Since the emergence of extensive multivariate data, feature fusion has been more and more important. Most conventional methods of feature fusion do not pay sufficient attention to inherent geometric properties of data, even in the case where the data have spatial features. Therefore, how to fuse multiple features in a more intuitive way is still an open problem. A new strategy of parallel graphical feature fusion is introduced in this paper. The original time series was first divided into subspace, then extracting multi-dimensional features in each subsequence space and mapping to points in high-dimensional space, and giving the geometry object representation in high dimensional feature space of the feature points, finally extracting the geometric features of the geometry object. One task of the research is to use geometry algebraic language to describe geometric objects of feature space and using geometry calculation to extract geometric features. In the two-dimensional space and three-dimensional space to build multi-ECG morphology triangles, determining the most effective parameters of the geometric structure and the pattern classification were done on five types of ECG time series of the MIT/BIH arrhythmia database. It got a high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Feature Fusion for Discriminating Oil Spill and Look-Alike Spots
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Oil spills and lookalikes (e.g. plant oil and oil emulsion) show the dark areas in SAR images, so it will bring some difficult in classifying the dark objects observed in full polarization SAR images into oil spills or lookalikes. In this paper, an approach is presented for distinguishing the dark areas in SAR images, which based on polarization features, geometric features and texture features fusion. In extracting the features, 18 different kinds of features consisting of 4 polarization features, 6 geometric features and 8 texture features are extracted. In the features analysis step, six features, which have good distinction, are selected to yield the optimal feature subsets. In the end, artificial neural network is used to classify the dark areas into oil spills or lookalikes. The proposed approach is applied to a data set of 14 oil spills and 6 lookalikes. The classification rate obtained by using the best set of features is 95%.

articleTitle: Research on the Efficiency of Wireless Power Transfer System Based on Multi-Auxiliary Transmitting Coils
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Recently, Wireless power Transfer has become a hot issue, because saving wires leads to the improvement of security and convenience. For Wireless power Transfer, the magnetic resonance coupling is a key research technique. It can work over large air gaps with high efficiency. Based on magnetic resonance coupling, in this paper, we study the power transfer efficiency of the Wireless power Transfer system with multi-auxiliary transmitting coils. By comparing the efficiency of different number of auxiliary transmitting coils, we derive the principle of selecting the appropriate number of auxiliary transmitting coils in different applications and provide a useful reference for designing practical Wireless power Transfer system.

articleTitle: Research on Transmission Waveform Structure and Rate Scaled of New Generation Data Link
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Tactical Targeting Networks Technology (TTNT) is the latest generation of data link technology. This paper first introduces the basic technical situation and performance of the technology. Secondly, according to the technical characteristics of the new technology, the basic structure of the waveform is analyzed, and the waveform structure of the parallel transmission is given. Finally, according to the characteristics of symbol rate adjustable, the rate adjustment model is given and simulated.

articleTitle: Method of Battlefield Target Information Sharing Based on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Modern warfare is mainly based on the joint operation of multiple armies, but there exists the phenomenon of information chimney in different armed services and it can hardly realize the information sharing in the existed command and control system. In this paper, a new method of battlefield target information sharing based on ontology is proposed. Firstly, the target detection information databases of navy, army and air are converted to resource description framework (RDF); Secondly, a method of ontology mapping is used for RDF alignment to realize the sharing of target information; Finally, using SPARQL to query the shared target information and verify the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Routing Protocol for Underwater Acoustic Networks Using Shortest Path Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To monitor the large area covered by water desirably, underwater acoustic networks have grown rapidly in the recent decade. However, due to the differences between terrestrial radio propagation and underwater acoustic propagation, it is crucial to design energy efficient routing protocols for underwater acoustic network. In this paper, we propose a power efficient clustered routing protocol named CRSP (Clustered Routing based Shortest Path). In CRSP, the monitoring area is divided into small cylinders called a layer, which has the same radius and height. The nodes located in the same layer were grouped into clusters, where the node with the lowest priority determined by residual energy and distance is selected as cluster head. In order to find the optimal routing among the cluster headers, the shortest path algorithm with redistributive heap is proposed, where the transmission energy consumption and the residual energy are taken into consideration. The experimental results show that CRSP performs better than the existing representative protocols in terms of energy consumption, network lifetime and end-to-end delay.

articleTitle: Fractional Order PID Control of Temperature of Supply Cooling Water
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: PID is by far the most dominating method for cooling-water pump control in refrigeration station systems. However, PID may cause oscillations when load changes. If the parameter of PID controller is not tuned appropriately, overshoots will occur and adjustment time becomes longer [2]. But fractional PID controller has better dynamic performance than traditional PID controller. Fractional order PID controller has stronger robustness, and can better ensure system's stability when interference is added to the system [1]. This paper mainly studies the fractional PID controller for control of temperature of supply cooling-water in central air conditioning system. The data model of the cooling tower is parameterized with the help of MATLAB curve fitting toolbox. Based on a large number of experimental data, the transfer function model of the controlled object is established. The simulation results show that fractional PID controller can make the speed of cooling-water pump respond to the changing load more quickly and overshoot is smaller compared with traditional PID controller.

articleTitle: The Optimization of HEVC Intra Prediction Mode Selection
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to reduce the computational complexity of the intra prediction module in HEVC, this paper proposes an optimization method for intra prediction mode selection. First, the size of the prediction block PU in HEVC is obtained. For 4×4 size PU block, the prewitt operator is used to extract the texture direction. Then, we judge whether the texture direction is obvious or not. If it is obvious, we use the angle mode corresponding to the texture direction and the modes of MPM to participate rate distortion calculation. If it is not obvious, we use mode 0, mode 1, the mode of minimum SATD and the modes of MPM to participate rate distortion calculation. For others size PU block, we use the most probable prediction mode MPM to filter the pre-selected list calculated by rough selection process. In this way, we can reduce the number of prediction modes participating rate distortion calculation. The experimental results shows that the proposed algorithm can reduce the encoding time by 32.42%, while the coding bit rate only increases by 0.25%, BDPSNR only reduces about 0.06dB. This algorithm meets the requirement of the complexity reduction and effectively reducing the encoding time.

articleTitle: Research Status and Development Trend of Laser Additive Manufacturing Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Laser additive manufacturing (LAM) technology is one of the most representative of advanced manufacturing technology, and one of the most critical technology, is currently a hot research at home and abroad. This paper mainly introduces the forming principle, characteristics and research status of two typical LAM technologies--selective laser melting (SLM) technology and laser cladding deposition (LCD) technology. Moreover, some application examples of LAM technology are listed, and its future development trend is discussed.

articleTitle: An On-line Calibration Method of SINS/Odometer Integrated Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Considering the key factors that affect the precision of strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) and odometer integrated navigation system, an on-line calibration method based on Kalman filter aided by odometer is proposed. Dead reckoning (DR) algorithm and DR error model including odometer scale factor and odometer installation errors are given. Based on the error model, a closed-loop Kalman filter is designed to estimate odometer scale factor error, odometer installation errors, gyroscope drifts and accelerometer biases, and then improve the horizontal position precision. Finally, the simulation of SINS/odometer integrated navigation is carried out. Correlated results show that current parameters including odometer scale factor and odometer installation can be estimated on the base of former parameters, and compared with the horizontal position calculated by dead reckoning algorithm, the proposing method exerts a higher horizontal position precision, which sufficiently verifies the validity of proposing method.

articleTitle: Feature Selection Based on Features Unit
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Feature selection is to select certain quantity of important features from large number of original features. In this paper, a new feature selection algorithm based on features unit (FU) is presented. The algorithm uses entropy of information to determine whether a feature should integrate with other features on the basis of its relevance to the class. As for the features which fit to integrate with others, also determine their jointing partners and build features units. Each features unit is inseparable and participates feature selection as a basic unit. The performance of FU is compared with other well known methods which are also based on information measurement. The experiments results show that the proposed FU is effective in feature selection.

articleTitle: Network Interface UPnP Mechanism of IEEE 1451 Smart Sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to achieve network interface plug and play (PnP) of IEEE 1451 networked smart sensor, this paper presents network interface's universal plug and play (UPnP) mechanism of IEEE 1451 networked smart sensor. Firstly, UPnP based IEEE 1451 networked smart sensor system structure is set up. The self-recognition information conversion between IEEE 1451 model and UPnP model are elaborated. Scheduling delay based sensing service discovery protocol (SD-SSDP) and information axiom based multi-index sensing device optimization (IA-MISDO) are proposed and researched specially. Then IEEE 1451/UPnP network bridge is designed to realize data format conversion, command format conversion, self-recognition information conversion and protocol conversion. The simulation experiment result shows that the correct reception rate of response message of SD-SSDP is 100%. The real experiment result shows that modified UPnP based IEEE 1451 networked smart sensor system's device update success rate is higher than 98.89% and its service update success rate is higher than 98.86%.

articleTitle: Optimal Combination Strategy for Two Swim-Out Acoustic Decoys to Countermeasure Acoustic Homing Torpedo
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The optimal combination strategy for two swim-out acoustic decoys to countermeasure acoustic homing torpedo is studied. The kinetics models of torpedo, submarine and decoys are established, followed with homing algorithm and re-search strategy of torpedo. Based on the assessment criterion of decoys playing against acoustic torpedoes, the genetic algorithm is applied to obtain the optimal countermeasure strategy for the submarine using two decoys under different torpedo warning angles, where the countermeasure strategy considers decoy fire time, decoy turn angles, decoy speeds, submarine evading angle and evading speed. Simulation results show the validity and rapidity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mutual Electromagnetic Influence between Transmission Line and Buried Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As Chinese economy continues to grow, the demand for energy is growing, and transmission lines and gas pipeline construction are in rapid development. As the selecting principles of the power industry and the oil and gas industry on the transmission path are very similar, the parallel closeness and crossing between lines and pipelines occur occasionally, and the impact of transmission lines on oil and gas pipelines has become increasingly prominent. In order to analyze the electromagnetic effect of the 330kV dual channel (two parallel single circuit erected) AC transmission lines on the adjacent oil and gas transmission pipeline, the electromagnetic environment of the oil and gas transmission pipeline adjacent to a 330 kV AC transmission line was carried out by Ansoft software.

articleTitle: The Data Analysis and the Database Construction for Pleurotus Eryngii Product Traceability System
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: For Pleurotus eryngii product traceability system, the database design is the foundation of traceability system development and the key to achieve the efficient operation of the system. On the one hand, Pleurotus eryngii, compared with other agricultural products, has different growth characteristics and production process, which makes Pleurotus eryngii strict requirements of the growth environment. On the other hand, Pleurotus eryngii production enterprises manage the production in accordance with the Process Flow Cards as the paper form, which leads to the low efficiency of management. Aims to these problems, the database of Pleurotus eryngii product traceability system is designed. Firstly, basic concepts of Pleurotus eryngii production process are introduced. Secondly, mathematical model is given based on operations definition and environmental factors definition. Thirdly, in view of quality security management, traceability code is designed. Fourthly, the database structure of Pleurotus eryngii product traceability system is analyzed and designed. Implementation of this database provides the technological support to the design of Pleurotus eryngii traceability system, and provides the basic data for optimizing the edible fungi varieties.

articleTitle: An Auction Based Profit-Aware Resource Allocation Mechanism for Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper investigates the resource allocation mechanism in infrastructure as a service (Iaas) cloud computing, in which the resources are offered in the form of virtual machine (VM) instances to users based on the pay-as-you-go model. We aim to maximize the profit of cloud service provider (CSP) meanwhile ensure that the resources are utilized efficiently. We exploit the auction-based model and propose a polynomial-time approximation scheme to solve the VM allocation problem. In particular, users in the cloud are allowed to submit bids for the heterogeneous resources in the combination of VM instances, in order to determine the invoice the users have to pay by using the allocated resources, we design the system into an equilibrium so that the users do not have incentives to submit their hybrid VM requests and bids untruthfully. Extensive simulations show that the proposed mechanism can achieve near optimal allocation and resilient to the manipulation of untruthful competitions.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization of Distributed Real-Time Computing System JStorm
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Distributed real-time computing system JStrom significantly improves performance on real-time data computing. However, JStorm may lead to a single point of failure, and upgrading JStorm system may cause instability of system. To efficiently solve these problems, we propose a task detection model based on the heartbeat detection and a two-level cluster load balancing model separately. We discover the running state of task through heartbeat detection algorithm, and take action accordingly to avoid single point of failure. The two-level cluster load balancing model divides large cluster into sub cluster, which is isolated and upgraded one by one. Our experimental results suggest that our model can efficiently solve the underlying problems of JStorm system, significantly improve the stability of the system, reduce the probability of single point of failure and the latency of cluster process, and keep system stability during the upgrade process.

articleTitle: An Image Quality Assessment Index Based on Visual Saliency and Gradient Amplitude for Telemedicine Application
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an image quality assessment method based on visual saliency and gradient amplitude. Multi-scale decomposition is used, then with the analysis of the image's phase spectrum in frequency domain, the visual saliency map can be obtained. Meanwhile, the gradient amplitude map is obtained through analyzing the image's contrast feature. The weighted products of the visual saliency map and the gradient amplitude map of all scales are synthesized to get the objective quality evaluation value. Many experiments are made on three image quality assessment (IQA) databases which are available to the public, including TID2008, IVC and A57. The experimental results demonstrate that the method proposed in this paper can obtain greater consistency with human subjective evaluation than that of other related image quality assessment indexes.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional DOA Estimation Based on Separable Observation Model Utilizing Weighted L1-Norm Penalty and Bayesian Compressive Sensing Strategy
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A novel approach for two-dimensional direction of arrival (2D-DOA) estimation based on separable observation model utilizing weighted L1-norm penalty and multitask Bayesian compressive sensing is proposed. Unlike previous DOA estimation methods based on the separable observation model, the proposed method has a better performance at the circumstance of low SNRs and small scale planar array. This approach employs weighted L1-norm penalty method to increase the reconstruction accuracy of elevations firstly. Then multitask Bayesian compressive sensing method is applied to reconstruct the sparse matrix. As the Bayesian compressive sensing method doesn't need the residual information produced during reconstructing the auxiliary variable, thus avoiding selecting regularization parameters, giving rise to better robust performance of the method. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Application of Bidirectional Pressurized Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This article mainly introduces the structure design and application of bidirectional booster cylinder to provide technical support for the manufacture of natural gas compression equipment. As a result, by calculating the static structure of the hydraulic cylinder and the pressure to be borne, we finally determined the structure of the hydraulic cylinder. The structure saves equipment manufacturing costs, reduces installation difficulty, and improves runtime safety.

articleTitle: Study on the Seismic Response of Polymer Anti-Seepage Wall
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Polymer anti-seepage wall is a new technology for the reinforcement of earth dikes and dams. It has been widely applied in the reinforcement of earth-rock dams, which produces good social, economic and environmental effect and has the prodigious value of popularization and application. Aiming at the shadow area and application key point of the new technology-seismic response of polymer anti-seepage wall, the study is carried out. Using finite element software ABAQUS, the three-dimentional numerical calculation model of earth-rock dams with polymer anti-seepage wall is established with consideration of the elastoplasticity of earth rockfill materials and contact elements between the dam and the wall. The seismic response of polymer anti-seepage wall is researched including stress, acceleration and displacement. The related laws of seismic response of the wall are obtained in the article.

articleTitle: The Application of PVPI Controller in the Cascade D-STATCOM System
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The current tracking control strategy is the key technology to realize dynamic reactive power regulation and harmonic current compensation in D-STATCOM system. In order to improve the precision and dynamic response speed of the D-STATCOM, a direct current control algorithm based on proportional vector proportional integral (PVPI) was proposed. The principle, performance and parameters of the controller are introduced in detail, The effectiveness and reliability of control algorithm are verified by simulation and has been tested on a practical installation of 3.3kV, ±1.5Mvar, and has higher engineering value.

articleTitle: Parametric Simulation and Analysis of Oxygen Detection Based on Wavelength Modulation Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Modulation parameters are main factors of wavelength modulation spectroscopy (WMS) technique because they can influence both performance and accuracy of the detection system by changing absorption signal characteristics. Absorption spectroscopy parameters of oxygen near 760nm were obtained through the HIRTAN database, simulation model of oxygen detection system was designed with the second harmonic linear expressions, and process of wavelength modulation spectroscopy and second harmonic signal extraction were simulated. Simulation results show that the best center wavelength is 760.885 nm and the best wavelength offset is 20 pm, which can obtain by adjusting the laser's DC bias current and scanning current respectively, and the modulation index is chosen between 1 and 2.2. This simulation test is very helpful to giving pertinent parameters of the real oxygen detection system.

articleTitle: Point-Based Incremental Pruning for Monte-Carlo Tree Search
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Monte-Carlo tree search (MCTS) combines the generality of stochastic simulation and the accuracy of tree search, which has attracted the great attention of scholars. However, the MCTS search requires a sufficient number of iterations to converge to a good solution, which is more difficult to optimize. In order to solve this problem, this paper presents a point-based incremental pruning (PIP) for Monte-Carlo tree search. Instead of reasoning about the whole policy trees space when pruning the cross-sums of the value functions during policy construction, our algorithm uses boundary belief points to perform exact pruning, and exploits intermediate points to perform approximate pruning by generating policy trees, then uses real-time belief states to get the optimal policy in policy execution. The theoretical analysis and empirical results indicate that PIP can speed up the tree search efficiently.

articleTitle: Attitude Tracking of Rigid Spacecraft with Bounded Input
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Attitude control is essential for spacecraft to accomplish various tasks, and the attitude tracking is one of the most important attitude control tasks. In this paper the attitude tracking of a rigid spacecraft with bounded input is examined. At the same time, the unknown external disturbances are finite, but their boundaries are unknown. In order to make sure the attitude tracking errors converge to zero, the nonlinear system model and problem formulation are obtained using quaternion method. Meanwhile a novel adaptive-robust-sliding mode control algorithm is designed, which can be applied in spacecraft systems with large parametric uncertainty or even with unknown inertial matrix. At last simulation results can illustrate the effectiveness of the control law.

articleTitle: Study on Elastic SDOF System Viscous Damping Coefficient Based on Energy Balance Principle
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Traditional simplified damping models have a great deviation from the practical situation, so a better one based on the energy balance principle is proposed here. Step-by-step integration method is used to get the theoretical expression of each energy term in energy-balance equation. Then an elastic SDOF system under seismic is taken for an example to obtain the dynamic effect, the energy distribution and the energy conversion process under the viscous damping. Finally, a new viscous damping coefficient is provided as a reference for dynamic structural analysis. The proposed model can well satisfy the demand of the energy balance principle.

articleTitle: Clustering Based Multiple Hypothesis Multi-Target Localization
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Cooperative detection system, which combines selforganizing network and single radar system, improves the ability of cooperative localization by distributed multi-node using multi-direction scattering power of target. Multiplehypothesis (MH)-Based Algorithm for Target Localization finds all possible targets using multi-path echo information with unknown number of targets, and realizes multi-target localization by generating global hypothesis. However, a large number of targets will cause the large computational complexity of MH-Based Algorithm for Target Localization. For this problem, this paper proposes a new method of Clustering Based Multiple Hypothesis Multi-target Localization, which decomposes a large number of hypotheses into several independent clusters, and hypothesis updating, hypothesis pruning and global hypothesis generating will be implemented independently in each cluster. Compared with MH-Based Algorithm for Target Localization, the proposed method increases the computation efficiency.

articleTitle: The Software Design of Dynamic Loading Identification System of Rock Roadheader
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The identification accuracy of dynamic loadings for the rock roadheader has significant impact on economic benefits and safety productions in coal mines. Aiming at the problems that there are difficulty regarding dynamic load real-time identification when the rock road-header is performing cutting tasks under changing loads, this paper designs software real-time identification when the rock road-header is performing cutting tasks under changing loads, this paper designs software architecture of dynamic load real-time identification system. Develop application software programs in the LABVIEW environment such as multi-parameter synchronous acquisition, wavelet packet analysis, data storage management, man-machine interface display and debug functions. The experimental results show that the application software is feasible.

articleTitle: Research of the Capability Open Platform in Mobile Cellular Network Based on the BS Data
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The rapid development of intelligent terminals and mobile Internet industry has brought many challenges and opportunities to the mobile network. Mobile Network Open Services can provide users and developers with the open resources consisted of network infrastructure, network data and diversified services, so as to build an open, flexible, collaborative Internet ecosystem. The ability to open the mobile network allows multiple partners to explore new business models, and to find the potential of mobile networks and pipeline value, to provide users with better service. For the needs of interconnection and intercommunication network within all depth integration, this paper focused on the research and application of capability open platform in mobile cellular network called M-COP. And this paper proposed the core content, logic architecture, network architecture, scenarios and technical solutions of M-COP, and proposed three typical services including positioning and location information services, business localization services and acceleration services.

articleTitle: Image Denoising with a Low-Rank Preprocessing before BM3D
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we attempted to improve the denoising performance of BM3D. As one of the most efficient denoising algorithms, BM3D is the fastest method while achieving remarkable denoising performance. However, since it employs fixed and separable 3D transformation, it is not adaptive enough to represent structural image areas which results in poor performance on this areas. In addition, it is greatly influenced by noise levels. To overcome these problems, in this paper, we introduced an adaptive low-rank preprocessing and backtracking procedure before BM3D. The experimental results prove that the proposed method has a great improvement on BM3D. The proposed algorithm not only produces better denoising results than BM3D in most cases, but also adapts to a variety of noise levels.

articleTitle: Analysis of Spatial Accessibility for Rural School Redistricting in West China: A Case Study of the Primary Schools in Zhenyuan County, Yunnan Province
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: School planning is the main role of local education administrations, and is related to providing fairness in education. This paper uses GIS technology to analyze the distribution of rural primary schools in a mountainous county of China. Analyzing population, school distribution, relevant education resource databases, and combined altitude map, allowed us to calculate the spatial accessibility of every administrative village in the county. The main evaluation factors for school distribution are spatial accessibility, fairness, and efficiency. Using a spatial accessibility index, we constructed a Gravity Model and an Improvement Gravity Model to explore the spatial distribution of rural schools. Through our analysis, we found there were differences in regard to education resources, school distribution, and spatial accessibility in Zhenyuan County, where our study was conducted. In some villages, the education resources are inadequate, some villages the distance to school is too far, more than half of the villages were poorly for the accessibility to school. We suggest that when school adjustments are being made, instead of merely considering efficiency alone, fairness should also be taken into account. Providing rural students with a school near their home is the most suitable and beneficial situation for rural families.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Range Search
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: For the sake of privacy in range search, a new privacy-preserving range search protocol is proposed using cryptology technology. First, a privacy-preserving vector dominance protocol is suggested. Then, on base of the protocol, our scheme is presented in semi-honest model. Security and complexity are analyzed in the end. Different from previous protocols, the servers are not allowed to get anything useful.

articleTitle: Research on Anytime Algorithm Improved of Weapon-Target Assignment
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Weapon-target assignment process with uncertainty and unpredictability, sometimes need to be aborted, and then distribute the firepower units immediately when there are many new targets or an emergency. The assignment results may not be the global optimal, but should be the best under the influence of the current state, that is, the algorithm has anytime property. Now the algorithm to solve the question of weapon target assignment can be roughly divided into three types, including the traditional algorithm, the intelligent algorithm and the hybrid algorithm combined the above two kinds of algorithm. Aiming at the problem, the optimization goal is to make the kill probability maximum, we put forward an improved anytime algorithm based on the particle swarm taboo hybrid search algorithm to solve the model, the simulation results show that this algorithm has good stability, can stop calculation and give the current optimal solution at any time. It has important practical significance.

articleTitle: Condition Evaluation of Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper describes the effect of the condition evaluation of transmission line Cand the methods of condition evaluation mainly used in current. With a 500kV line as example, shows the process of condition evaluation of the transmission line. This paper also present the problems should be considered in the condition evaluation process. Aiming at the method of transmission line condition evaluation for the moment, this paper study the differentiation condition evaluation method according to the degree of significance and the level of risk, the result of the last condition evaluation, which has the positive significance to the state of the transmission line condition maintenance.

articleTitle: Improved VLAD with Multiple Codebooks and Deep Convolutional Descriptors
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The aggregate descriptors based on handcraft patch-level features have been successfully applied to content-based image retrieval. However, that most of these handcraft patch-level features lost semantic information limit the performance of aggregate descriptors. In this paper, we present an approach to encode the aggregate descriptors by off-the-shelf deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) which is trained with lots of semantic information. We first utilize the CNNs model to compute the outputs of multiple convolutional layers as patch-level features, then encode these features that come from different intermediate layers into multiple codebooks to construct the aggregate image descriptors. Experiments demonstrate that our multiple aggregate image descriptors obtains state-of-the-art results.

articleTitle: Real-Time Periodic Task Scheduling Based on Compensation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of multi-core technology, most processors support DVFS (dynamic voltage and frequency scaling) Technology. Due to the introduction of DVFS technology, we can optimize the scheduling strategy to reduce energy consumption. Energy consumption can be reduced by equalizing load. In this paper we propose DULB with average compensation partition algorithm. We analyzed the partition algorithm by some experiments find that our algorithm has good effect in energy conservation. Compared with DULB, shows that adopting our algorithm an energy reduction of more than 15% can be achieved. When the task load of the system is moderate, adopting our algorithm an energy reduction of more than 20% can be achieved. When the task load of the multi-core system is below 90%, above 80% of the tasks could be scheduled by our partition algorithm.

articleTitle: Diffraction Effect in Compressive Sensing Ghost Imaging
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Compressive sensing ghost imaging has made great progress in recent years because it can reconstruct high-grade object image with less number of samples. In adition, using digital micromirror device (DMD) to set up light field has greatly promoted the development of practical application of ghost imaging, but many problems remained, such as ignoring the changes of light field in propagation. To do this, first of all, analyze the influencing factors of light propagation. The size of the lens makes the diffraction effect more obvious. The actual light field deviates from the preset value which is the result of bright floding. Calculate the intensity spread function of the diffraction limited system and modify the preset light field. However, the modified light field acting as observation matrix can still be reconstructed under the condition of mutual coherence. Experimental results indicate that the modified light field is similar to actual light field and observation matrix can reconstruct high-grade picture. So it is significant to modifify light field by intensity spread function.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Active Pendulum Control System for Fluid Damping Measurement
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: While a pendulum swings freely in fluid, the number of swings reflects the effect of fluid damping. Swinging during a fixed period as a gravity pendulum of a certain weight, the swing of the pendulum decays faster if the damping is larger, and more slowly if the damping is smaller [1]. An active pendulum device for damping measurement is presented in this paper. By measuring the power of the pendulum compensation when the pendulum swings with the same amplitude and frequency in fluids with different damping effects, the device can calculate the overall effect of fluid damping. First, a conical pendulum mechanical model of a free pendulum is established based on the principle of virtual displacement and D'Alembert's principle, and then the space trajectory of free pendulum motion and conical motion is studied by solving the Lagrange equation and taking into consideration the motion law of free swing compensation. Next, the PID algorithm is used to analyze the pendulum attitude data measured by the sensor, adjust the wind speed of the DC fan output and maintain the dynamic balance of the pendulum. The pendulum tested in the fan drive performs a simple harmonic swing in different fluids according to the given amplitude and frequency. The power of the system compensation is related to the fluid damping.

articleTitle: Trend Balanced Genetic Algorithm for Blending Optimization of Traditional Chinese Medicine
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To ensure the quality of traditional Chinese medicine is a key task for manufacturers of traditional Chinese medicine. In this paper, a novel method based on an improved trend balanced genetic algorithm is used for blending optimization in order to ensure the quality of traditional Chinese medicine. Our newly designed genetic algorithm is composed of 4 operators including a trend crossover operator, a trend mutation operator, a trend balance operator and a trend selection operator based on our trend balanced theory. In the experiment, our trend balanced genetic algorithm is more accurate and efficient than those of traditional genetic algorithm and non-linear least square method.

articleTitle: Influence of Structure Parameters on Dynamic Response of Small Wind Turbine Tower
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The dynamic response of small wind turbine tower under random wind load is studied, and the influence of the structure parameters, such as the outer diameter and wall thickness of the tower, on the vibration response and the bottom bending strength is studied. The stochastic wind speed is simulated by using the harmonic superposition method with FFT, The random load is calculated by the blade element- momentum theory, Based on the simplified model of wind turbine dynamics, the vibration response of the tower is obtained, and the bending strength of the tower bottom is checked. The calculation results show that it is helpful to control the maximum displacement and the maximum bending stress at the bottom of the tower in the safe operation range of the tower, and is significant to reduce cost, lightweight and safe operation by the proper selection of structure parameters.

articleTitle: Contrast Changed Image Quality Assessment Based on Dual-Path Feature-Difference Network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Contrast plays an important role in human visual perception while it is usually unsatisfactory due to various factors in the acquisition process of images. With numerous approaches proposed to enhance contrast, less work has been dedicated to contrast changed image quality assessment (IQA). In this work, we propose a quality assessment model based on dual-path feature-difference, which uses a dual-channel convolution neural network (CNN) to extract features, removing the common feature of reference image and distorted image and preserving the feature-difference caused by contrast change. Then, image quality scores are estimated based on feature-difference maps. Moreover, a patch contrast quality map can also be created during the score prediction process, which is useful for the optimization of the image contrast enhancement algorithms. Validations based on multiple publicly available datasets show that the proposed method is well correlated with subjective evaluations of contrast changed image quality.

articleTitle: Research on Data Model and Integration Technology of New Energy Power System
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the improvement of informatization level, the establishment of the enterprise data model and the integration of heterogeneous data are particularly important in the process of the new energy electric power enterprise informatization construction. This paper studies the theory of enterprise data model and IEC61970/61968 model standards, and the impact factors of wind power generation and photovoltaic power generation. The corresponding prediction model and the data model of the equipment domain are established. In addition, the operation analysis system has been designed and implemented, the system has functions of the prediction of power and the statistical analysis to running data, etc. This paper also studies the key problem to solve in the data integration, and according to the characteristics of the related parameters in the wind power generation and photovoltaic power generation, the data integration platform has been designed and implemented.

articleTitle: Research on Improved K-Means Algorithm Based on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The approaching of big data era makes traditional data storage methods could not accomplish the mass tasks of analysis, managing and mining. While the rise of cloud computing brings new life to parallel improvement of data mining algorithms. Its efficient programming model, massive storage capacity and powerful computing capabilities provide a broad platform for the development of data mining. Hadoop uses MapReduce programming model for distributed computing and HDFS distributed file system for file storage. This paper studied the K-means algorithm in the clustering algorithm in detail. Through the sampling of large-scale data, this paper used convex hull and the solution of the heel point to solve the initial two clustering centers to modify algorithm process. Through the MapReduce programming model, it achieved the entire process of parallelization. Finally, it compared the efficiency of the improved algorithm with different distance measurement methods, along with serial parallel mode and different cluster nodes in experiments. With the increasing of cluster nodes and data scale, reliability and computational efficiency of improved parallel algorithm are improved obviously.

articleTitle: Effects of the Length of Rotor Wafters on Rotor Temperature Rise for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The rotor heat load of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) occupies a large proportion of the total heat load. The length of rotor wafters has a great influence on rotor temperature rise. In order to research its influence, based on heat transfer theory and hydrodynamics, the thermal calculation model and three-dimensional flow model of PMSM are established. Then, the main heat source of the motor is measured and the heat dissipation coefficients of each part of the motor are calculated, ANSYS WORKBENCH software is used to analyze and compare the temperature rise of the rotor under different length of rotor wafters. The influence of rotor wafters on rotor temperature rise for permanent magnet synchronous motor is summarized, it provides a theory evidence for further studies on temperature rise of permanent magnet synchronous motor.

articleTitle: Research on Parallel Frequent Pattern Discovery Based on Ontology and Rules
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Frequent pattern discovery is a hotspot of knowledge discovery, which is based on the hybrid knowledge base that consists of ontology and rule logic. However, the mining efficiency of it is too low and unsatisfying, since the reasoning process needs large quantities of computing. Thus, we need to develop the parallel algorithm and architectures to solve this problem. In this paper, we come up with a parallel Inductive Logic Programming(ILP) frequent pattern discovery method based on MapReduce Framework, and then establish the Trie Tree by node expansion algorithm. Finally, we distribute the various computational pattern detection processes to each parallel computing nodes in the Frequent Pattern Tree(FPT) and get the frequent pattern. This way can also eliminate the semantic redundancy, which is judged by support degrees. Consequently, by the verification in experiments, we find this frequent pattern discovery algorithm can improve the efficiency of pattern discovery in a large degree.

articleTitle: Design of High Voltage Power Supply Control System of Stationary Digital Breast Tomosynthesis Based on NI CompactRIO
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the Stationary Digital Breast Tomosynthesis(s-DBT) system, the role of the focusing electrode is to obtain clearer scanned images by focusing the electrons emitted by the carbon nanotubes. As one part of the control system of the s-DBT, the real-time control system of the focusing electrode high voltage power supply is designed. The control system using the NI CompactRIO device and LabVIEW as platform. The hardware unit mainly includes NI CompactRIO 9068, analog output module NI 9263 and analog acquisition module NI 9201. The software design includes the allocation of I/O ports, the choice of CompactRIO development architecture, the design of the power supply control's flow chart and the generation of dynamic link library. Through the construction of the test platform, the control system's feasibility and reliability were tested, analysis of the experimental data shows that the control system's relative error of the high voltage power supply's voltage control is less than 0.5%.

articleTitle: Developing of a SCADA System for a Water Multi-Heating System
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A water multi-heating system including solar, heat pump and gas heating was introduced to heat water in an energy-saving way. Then the SCADA system for it was presented in detail. First, the design scheme for the main peripheral circuits of the microcontroller and GUI were introduced. Secondly, the control strategy, aiming at reducing the cost of the heating system, was then proposed and implemented based on the prediction of the uptrend of water temperature by solar heating. To solve the uncertainty of the rising trend of water temperature by solar heating, three basic standard curves of different meteorological conditions were obtained based on a massive number of data observed and acted as references to predict the uprising of the water temperature in a specific day. Experimental results show the feasibility and accuracy of the design scheme in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on RFID Squelch Algorithm Using Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, wavelet threshold de-noising method is proposed to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of RFID radio frequency communication signal. Firstly, the performance and characteristics of RFID signals are introduced. Then, several comparable de-noising methods are illustrated. Finally, soft threshold de-noising and hard threshold de-noising methods are utilized to reduce the noise. The simulation results show that these methods effectively eliminate the noise in the RFID signal and the reserved signal has high fidelity.

articleTitle: Investigation on Advances in Wind Tunnel Model Attitude Determination Systems and Techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The accuracy of wind tunnel model attitude determination is one of the main factors influencing data quality especially drag coefficient due to use in coordinate transformation between model axis and wind axis for internal strain gauge balances. To improve angle of attack and sideslip angle measurement accuracy and precision in a wind tunnel, a series of sensors and measurement systems have been developed. This paper presents the advantages and drawbacks of the dominant systems and analyzes their key techniques. The future research suggestions are addressed in the end.

articleTitle: CT Reconstruction from Limited-View Cone-Beam Projections Using 3D Image Moments
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Limiting the views of cone-beam CT scan can effectively reduce the damage to the human's health brought by X-rays when taking CT examination. However, the CT images reconstructed from the limited-view cone-beam projections will degrade greatly. To improve the quality of the reconstructed images when the cone-beam projections are incomplete, this paper proposes a new method by using 3D image moments for limited-view cone-beam CT reconstruction. It uses 3D geometric moments to establish the relationship between 3D Radon data and image moments. After converting the cone-beam projection acquired in limited views into known 3D Radon data, we use this relationship to estimate unknown 3D Radon data from known ones. In this way, 3D Radon data become complete. Finally, with help of the inverse formula of the first derivative of the 3D Radon transform, we reconstruct the 3D CT images from the complete 3D Radon data. The experimental results show that our method has good performance in limited-view CT reconstruction. The experimental results show that our method can improve the reconstructed cone-beam CT images when only limited-view projections are given.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Image Tampering Detecting Algorithm of Remote Healthcare Platform
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Active detection technology was widely used in the traditional tampering detection. Firstly, those mainstream technologies of active detection were introduced. Then, some necessary improvements for the tampering detection algorithm were proposed in this paper, for example, the steganography information was cross-embedded to enhance the safety of the images, and the chaos function was simplified to enhance the execution efficiency and detection precision of the algorithm. Experimental results showed that the proposed algorithm can improve the efficiency of image tamper detection.

articleTitle: Research on Multiple Objection Operation Strategy Optimization of Distribution Network Including Distributed Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With continuous improvement of the retention rate of household electrical appliances, the peak valley difference of power distribution network, especially the rural distribution network is expanding. A reasonable management method of the demand side is needed to realize load shifting and economic operation of distribution network. At present, the cost of energy storage(ES) equipment is decreasing, which provides a new idea for the optimization of distribution network operation. This paper studied the charge/discharge model and strategy of ES, and constructed a multi-period optimal operation strategy model of distribution network with ES. Sparse coding automatic differentiation technology was applied to reduce coding workload, and constraint reduction of ES was proposed to reduce differential calculation, which enhanced the feasibility and efficiency of the model solving. Finally, the simulation results of an actual distribution network with ES demonstrated the accuracy of the proposed model, the efficiency of the proposed algorithm and the feasibility of the proposed solving method.

articleTitle: Research on Semantic Extraction Method in Chinese Electronic Medical Records
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In China, the technology of information extraction is widely used in many fields and the most notable one is medical science. Chinese electronic medical records(CEMRs) contain tremendous information and is of great value, however, free text like CEMRs cannot be directly used for analysis. In order to extract valuable information from CEMRs, this paper put forward a method to extract key information from unstructured CEMRs and has achieved preferable results. This paper is composed of three parts. The first part proposes semantic extraction model which is composed of three parts, namely, text segmentation, semantic disambiguation and semantic extraction. The following part explains the three modules of this model in detail. In order to improve semantic extraction accuracy, this paper proposes the algorithm of semantic disambiguation which is meant for CEMRs. Equipped with the sentence pattern library, Semantic extraction module is designed to extract key information from CEMRs and populate templates with extracted information in order to generate XML output. The last part is about experiment. The method proposed in this paper can be validated through experiment and result of the experiment can be applied to evaluate this method.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Task Auto-Testing Line System for Metering Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, automatic technologies have been gradually applied in the batch testing process of energy measuring devices. Different from energy meters and acquisition terminals, the metering current transformers have more than ten specifications (various in size, transformation ratio, etc), and the demands for testing are more dispersed. This leads to a large number of scattered work tasks on the auto-testing line, which reduces its operational efficiency and utilization. In this paper, we propose a flexible multi-task system applied in the auto-testing process of metering current transformers. Through concurrent dispatching mechanism and parallel layout design, the system can carry out multiple testing tasks from different specifications simultaneously. Practical application results show that this design idea optimizes the working efficiency with limited occupation of space.

articleTitle: Research on Vibrating String Transducer Used in Online Monitoring System of Tailings Dam
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the measuring principle of vibrating string transducer was studied and the mathematical model of its monitoring principle was deduced, then its application condition in tailings dam online monitoring system was demonstrated and successfully applied in the project. On the basis of comparison result between the data measured by vibrating string transducer and manual measurement, the author draws the conclusion that the vibrating string transducer could exactly reflect the safety index of tailings dam and its accuracy could meet the requirement of online monitoring of tailings dam.

articleTitle: Mapping the Intellectual Structure of Relationship between Usability of Information System and User Emotion
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper conducts co-word analysis and social network analysis to review the research of relationship between usability of information system and user emotions. The results show that more and more studies focus on the topic which involves three perspectives, namely products design and evaluation, human-computer interaction design and evaluation, interface design and evaluation. The main issues include affective computing, user experience, aesthetics, affect, satisfaction, interface design, motivation, product evaluation, affective tutoring system and interaction design. However, these studies are within active and junior periods generally, and the concrete topics and issues are relatively decentralized.

articleTitle: Early Eviction of Non-Reusable Journal Data in Smartphone Buffer Cache Management
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to resist sudden power failures, smartphone systems usually manipulate file writes via SQLite journaling, which incurs writes to another file. Although this file will never be used unless system crash occurs, it resides in the buffer cache, thereby polluting the precious cache space. In this paper, we present a novel buffer cache management scheme for smartphone systems that aggressively evicts non-reusable journal data from the buffer cache. Specifically, our scheme classifies data not to be accessed again like SQLite journal data, and performs early eviction from the buffer cache to improve cache space utilization. Experimental results with various real smartphone applications show that the proposed buffer cache management scheme improves the cache miss ratio by 21% on average. We also show that this improvement can reduce the buffer cache size significantly without performance degradations, which would allow for the reduction of energy consumption in a smartphone memory system.

articleTitle: A Software for Numerically Calculating and Simulating Plume Infrared Radiation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to calculate plume infrared radiation conveniently, a software for numerically calculating and simulating plume infrared radiation was developed. Firstly, in the Visual Studio 2008 development environment, the software user interface was created. Secondly, the numerical methods for calculating radiative luminance of the non-gray medium were analyzed. Thirdly, the infrared radiation of a cylindrical plume was calculating by using the infinite volume method. And the results of spectral radiative luminance, spectral radiative intensity and band radiative intensity were obtained and their data could be saved in files. Finally, according to the results, the curves of the spectral radiative luminance, spectral radiative intensity and band radiative intensity were plotted; and the gray images were obtained by simulating the space distribution of the plume band radiative intensity. Under the same condition, the results obtained by using the software was coincident with the results obtained by using Matlab. It showed that the key tasks of numerically calculating and simulating plume infrared radiation could both be operated correctly by using the software.

articleTitle: Research on the Course Discrimination Based on Gray Wolf Algorithm and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The division of the test paper can reflect the quality of examination paper, but it is difficult to find some decisive courses in dozens of courses. In order to find out the curriculum that decides the role of different levels of students, the concept of course discrimination is proposed, which focuses on the value of course discrimination, the classification method and the proportion of special courses selected at this time. For the sake of calculating the value of course discrimination, a method of wrapping feature selection is proposed, which combines gray wolf algorithm and support vector machine (GWO + SVM). So as to obtain the courses distinction of three specialties, eight algorithms were tested. The experimental results show that GWO+SVM is more suitable for calculating the courses distinction than other seven algorithms.

articleTitle: GPS/INS Integrated Navigation by Fading Filtering Based on Wavelet De-Noising
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The motion compensation of Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) and Micro- Electro Mechanical Inertial Navigation System (MINS) can effectively correct and compensate the motion errors of the Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) platform. In this paper, firstly, the long-term errors of the MINS have been analyzed and modeled using the Allan variance method under the view of time-frequency analysis. Secondly, the short-term errors in the motion characteristic bands have been reduced by utilizing the wavelet thresholding de-noising method to decrease the effects of gross errors on the system. Finally, the preprocessed data solution via dead reckoning has been conducted by using fading filtering algorithm. The experimental results have indicated that the proposed approach effectively reduces the influence of the errors of the inertia devices, preferably eliminates the gross errors, recovers the data and improves the precision of the GNSS / MINS integrated navigation system in order to obtain high quality SAR images.

articleTitle: A Probabilistic Maintenance Scheme Evaluation Method for Transformer Based on Failure Rate
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Reasonable maintenance for power transformer is critical to the long-term security operation of transformer. At present, the lack of support theory for transformer maintenance decision usually causes reliability and economy issues for power companies, which may cause "over maintenance" or "owing maintenance" problems. For this reason, a probabilistic maintenance scheme evaluation method for transformer based on failure rate is proposed by simulation of the health states of transformer with unexpected operation stress. Firstly, a first order model of transformer paper degradation is proposed to represent the health state of a transformer. Then, variations of Degree of Polymerization (DP) along with time are randomly generated using Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) based on the Weibull Distribution under different maintenance schemes. Then the failure rate (FR) curve of transformer is then determined. When the FR is higher than a pre-defined threshold value, the transformer should be replaced for reliability purpose. The effectiveness of the proposed maintenance scheme evaluation method is verified by a typical engineering application. Simulation results show that it can be used to determine an optimum maintenance scheme for transformer to avoid failure risk and reduce the maintenance cost of power companies.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Control Strategy for Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle Based on the Maximization of Powertrain Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the present study, a real-time control strategy has been proposed for the plug-in hybrid electric vehicle based on the maximization of the powertrain efficiency. The proposed method formulates a cost function representing the expression of the power-train's overall efficiency in different driving mode. Then the engine and ISG motor's output torque is determined in order to maximize the efficiency of the powertrain. The performance of the proposed method is analyzed and demonstrated on the model of the plug-in hybrid electric vehicle established in MATLAB/Simulink for different driving cycle conditions and the results have been compared with the logic threshold control strategy. The simulation results show that the proposed method provides a competitive performance with a better energy consumption economy compared to the logic threshold control strategy for different drive cycle conditions.

articleTitle: Research on the Utilization of Waste Heat from Flue Gas of Combined Cycle Unit
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This article proposes the research and application of flue gas waste heat utilization refrigeration technology in a combined cycle power plant. In this paper, two different types of waste heat utilization are analyzed, and the selection of flue gas waste heat utilization refrigeration mode, project technology and economic analysis under different boundary conditions are analyzed. The research and application of power plant waste heat utilization of the project to improve the feasibility of the program and the economic operation of the unit.

articleTitle: A Method of Dynamic Aggregation and Disaggregation Based on HLA
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The method of aggregation and disaggregation is one of the core methods of multi-resolution modeling (MRM), which is widely used in military simulation for its clear structure. In the process of disaggregation - aggregation - disaggregation, it is important to maintain the consistency of information when the resolution is changed. Because of the inconsistency, this paper classifies the interaction as short and continuity process to determine whether to aggregate or disaggregate completely. And information is also compensated according to the classification of attributes at the same time. While reducing the frequency of aggregation/disaggregation, the methods improve the accuracy of simulation by extra information compensation.
