Finally, the experiment on HLA verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the methods.

articleTitle: Research on Sliding Mode Control Strategy of Demotion Robot's Working Equipment by Means of ADAMS and Simulink
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Based on the working principle of the electrohydraulic proportional control system of the working device of the demolition robot, the co-simulation model of the system is established by means of ADAMS and MATLAB. The study of the dynamic characteristics of the system was done, with applying traditional PID control strategy and sliding mode variable structure control respectively, considering the change of the control object parameters caused by the pose change of the working device and the external disturbances. The co-simulation results show that the sliding mode variable structure control strategy has excellent dynamic performance, better robustness and faster response compared with traditional PID.

articleTitle: Identification of Combination of SNPs Associated with Crohn's Disease Using a Balanced Univariate Marginal Distribution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Detecting diseases associated SNPs is the central goal of genetics and molecular biology. However, highthroughput techniques often provide long lists of disease SNPs candidates, and the identification of disease SNPs among the candidates set remains timeconsuming and expensive. In addition, contrasting to the number of SNPs involved, the available datasets (samples) generally have fairly small sample size and the datasets used in these studies are often imbalanced (the number of cases and controls are not equal). Therefore, it is necessary to develop a robust tool to identify the disease associated SNPs. In this paper, we proposed a modified univariate marginal distribution algorithm (MUMDA) taking into account the imbalanced ratios of case/control for selecting the associated SNPs. In addition, the sparse vector encoding method was used in this paper. We illustrated the effectiveness of our algorithm using Crohn's disease (CD) dataset which includes 144 cases and 243 controls (each one has 103 SNPs). Our observations suggested that the proposed method could capture important features of the genetic architecture of CD and our algorithm outperformed other current methods.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction of Shield Machine Based on Rough Set and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to accomplish the fault prediction of complicated and enormous mechanical equipment, this paper proposed a fault prediction model for complicated mechanical equipment that based on rough sets theory and BP neural network . Firstly, the discretization of continuous data was implemented by the discretization algorithm based on dynamic hierarchical clustering in rough set theory; secondly, an improved algorithm based on discernibility function attribute reduction was used to reduce the decision table to remove redundant attributes of decision table, then the reduced data were input into BP neural network for fault prediction. Finally, case studies are conducted to predict the failure of cutterhead of shield machine.The experimental results showed that the prediction model can effectively reduced the input information, simplified the neural network architecture, shortened the training time and improved the efficiency and accuracy of fault prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Uncertainty of CORDIC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Coordinate rotation digital computer (CORDIC) algorithm can be used to implement a variety of transcendental functions. Using theory and techniques of uncertainty evaluation, we discuss the error sources and the total computational error of CORDIC algorithm in calculating arctangent, sine, and cosine functions. Besides, we reveal some conclusions for error propagation mechanism, which are not quite consistent with existing literature. Numerical simulation results are presented as well, which can verify the proposed expressions of uncertainty.

articleTitle: Shirt Version Intelligent Recommendation for Rapid Garment Customization
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper discusses the method for shirt version intelligent recommendation through combining human body data analysis and apparel loose quantity setting analysis. Firstly, we get the weight of each factor by Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and realize the recommendation of the best shirt shape through the garment size. Then by using the Back Propagation(BP) neural network, we input net body size and output corresponding garment size for supervised learning. Meanwhile, we get the weight of each factor after linear fitting and can calculate each part of the loose quantity through the net body. Finally, we check whether the recommended shape is fit through loose quantity fitness analysis. The version recommendation in this paper not only helps customers to find fit size, but also helps the manufacturers to calculate each part of the loose setting.

articleTitle: Evaluating Underlay Performance of Optimal Overlay Multicast
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Overlay multicast is regarded as a promising way for distributing file or live stream during recent years. In this paper, we reinforce an optimal DAGs (directed acyclic graphs) construction algorithm by relaxing its partitioning and sorting conditions. We employ a realistic topology (CERNET2 backbone) to evaluate several typical types of optimal DAGs in terms of the underlay performance metrics. Simulation results show that, both the maximum link utilization and the overall cost will decrease with the increasing of the number of sub streams. The link utilization curves appear similar even though the ways of partitioning and sorting nodes are different. Although the application layer and the network layer are designed to be transparent to each other, some characteristics of the overlay topologies can also be reflected in the underlay.

articleTitle: The Effect Analysis of Signal Skew on the ARINC659 Bus Bridging and Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to ensure the strict time synchronization between devices, to achieve the purpose of precise timing control and distributed control and resource sharing, we propose a bridging technique for ARINC659 backplane bus connection between different devices. The bridging technology ensures that the ARINC659 bus is physically independent and can logically take concerted action in step so that the hardware modules on ARINC659 bus can be used, shared and controlled as a unified resource. At the same time, in order to ensure that ARINC659 bus after bridging can run correctly, the effect of the signal skew on the bus communication and synchronization is analyzed, and the relationship between the length of the bridging bus and the signal skew and the bus synchronization period is obtained. Finally, the feasibility of ARINC659 bus bridging and the correctness of signal skew effect are verified by experiment and analysis. It provides guidance for engineering application and design constraint of ARINC659 bus bridging, and promotes the application of ARINC659 bus in aerospace field.

articleTitle: New Criteria for Nonsingular H-Matrices and Its Applications
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we give an equivalent condition of α- bidiagonally dominant matrices and obtain a set of practical criteria of H-matrices. Together with the algorithm that is proposed illustrative numerical example is provided.

articleTitle: A Novel Transmit Waveform Design Method Based on MMA
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we extend the information-based approach to the signal-dependent interference problem and propose a new model for optimal waveform design in signaldependent interference. We assume that the target is finiteduration Gaussian signal and investigate the mutual information (MI) in signal-dependent interference and channel noise. Based on maximization of the mutual information and the energy constraint, we can obtain the matched waveforms. However, the equations obtained by differentiation cannot easily be solved. Thus we utilize the very computationally efficient approach of Maximum Marginal Allocation (MMA) to solve the problem. Then we show several waveform design simulations and compare the optimal waveform. Finally, we prove the effectiveness of the new approach by the simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Error Evaluation of Planar Curve Profile Based on an Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To improve the measuring accuracy of planar curve profile error, an improved genetic algorithm is put forward to realize self-adaptive matching of measured curve, eliminating the position deviation during error evaluation of planar curve profile. It not only improves the efficiency and precision of the algorithm but also prevents premature convergence to local optimal solutions by introducing a relative fitness function, setting the dynamic mutation probability, and re-inserting. An instance of planar curve profile error evaluation is used to compare the improved genetic algorithm with the traditional genetic algorithm. The example of single running result shows that the improved genetic algorithm runs faster than the traditional one and its precision increases by 29.8%. The repeated running results also show a faster convergent speed of improved genetic algorithm and its precision increases by 39.1%, compared with the traditional one. After the self-adaptive matching of the measured curve by improved genetic algorithm, the planar curve profile error decreases by 52.4%, compared with the value without the curve matching.

articleTitle: Research on the Power State Estimation Based on the Combination of the Innovation Graph Approach and the Current Reckoning Method
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The scale of the network determines the need for system partition management, the network block partition estimation makes the state estimation problem of large network converse into two medium or small network. This paper proposes combination of the innovation graph approach and the current reckoning method to form a new partition identification method, which can achieve complementary advantages of the two methods and can performance comprehensive identification. In the process of partition, take several factors related to the regional characteristics and measurement configuration into account, there are differences in different regions by using the innovation graph approach or current reckoning method.

articleTitle: Self-Repairing Software Architecture for Predictable Hardware Faults
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Because of hardware faults, the situation that the processor cannot perform properly is occurred frequently in large scale software-intensive systems. Most of traditional fault-tolerant methods do not distinguish the type of hardware failure. In view of this, we propose self-repairing software architecture for predictable hardware faults. By introducing computational reflection, the software architecture designs and realizes a proactive processor fault tolerant manager to complete component active migration according to the result of the migration decision. So, users do not need to modify the code to complete the self-repairing process. Experimental results show the architecture help enable system to selfrepairing and reduce predictable hardware failure impact on the running software.

articleTitle: Analysis of Field Uniformity of MRI Magnet
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is the largest application of superconductivity. Field uniformity is important requirement to MRI magnet. Method of polynomial expansion is used in calculation of magnetic field of MRI magnet. Strategically arrangements of unshielded and shielded multiple coils are deduced on base of eliminating low order coefficients of coils. Shifts of coils along axial direction are taken into account to show influences of manufacture errors on field uniformity.

articleTitle: Novel Puncturing Strategy for Rate-Compatible Low-Density Parity-Check Codes with Diagonal Structure
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Puncturing is a good way to achieve Rate-Compatible (RC) family codes with high rate. In this paper, asimple yet efficient puncturing strategy for Low Density ParityCheck (LDPC) codes with diagonal structure is proposed andanalyzed. In order to minimize the recovery step of puncturednodes, all the parity nodes (PNs) are assumed being punctured atfirst and then recovered step by step. The algorithm is named asProgressive Node Recovery (PNR) and acquires puncturingorder reversely from recovery order. The diagonal structure ofmother code provides great convenience during the procedure.Extensive experimental results show that the PNR algorithm canreduce the performance loss caused by puncturing and thusguarantees the good error correction performance of RC familycodes with high code rates

Author Keywords: Low Density Parity Check Codes; Diagonal

articleTitle: Navigation and Guide System Design for the Smart Scenic Area
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to achieve sustainability in the context of advances in science and technology, it is necessary to transform the traditional tourist attractions into smart tourist attractions by combining smart and information technologies with scientific management. Navigation and guide is an important module of smart tourist attraction. A navigation and guide service system based on smart phone is proposed in this paper. Our work yields insights into the development of smart tourist attractions and the enhancement of tourist satisfactions.

articleTitle: An Effective Image Retrieval Method Based on Fractal Dimension Using Kernel Density Estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Fractal coding has been proved useful for image compression, and it is also proved effective for image retrieval. In the paper, we present a statistical method called variable bandwidth kernel density estimation to analyze fractal coding parameters. Then retrieve images using the retrieval parameters constructed with this method. Experimental results show that the proposed method with a variable optimized bandwidth performs better than those with a fixed bandwidth and the histogram method both in retrieval rate and retrieval speed. In this paper, the Average Retrieval Rate (ARR) can reach 72.40%, which is more than that obtained by the existing methods.

articleTitle: Study of Rock Desertification Processes and Driving Force in Southern Part of Yunnan, China, between 1994 and 2014 - A Case Study on Thirty Counties Based on Remote Sensing
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: China is one of the important rocky desertification regions, and this paper mainly study the karst mountainous area in southern part of Yunnan Province. Under the influence of climatic changes and human activities, the rocky decertified areas have experienced positive or negative phases in recent 50 years in south Yunnan. In this paper, based on the classification type and synthetically land-scape of rocky desertified land in the study area, using remote sensing, mapping, GIS analysis and statistical analysis, we analysed the temporal-spatio dynamics of rocky desertified lands and then reconstructed the developmental and evolutional processes of rocky desertification between 1974 and 2004. We found the rocky desertified land is initially reversed between the early 1970s and the late 1980s, and is duratively and acceleratively reversed between the late 1980s and the early 2000s. The analyses of the relationship between climatic changes, human activities and rocky desertification indicated that human activities are the main driving force to the development and reverse of rocky desertification, especially policy change has a leading effect, and its contribution rate is greater than the climatic force. Restricted by regional and complicated ecological process of rocky desertification, its dynamical mechanisms are complex, which are composed of interference driving forces, natural and human coupling driving factors, oriented influence policy and feedback between driving forces and rocky desertification.

articleTitle: The Precise Analytical Calculation of Fourth-Order Doppler Parameters for Geosynchronous SAR
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Compared with current Low-Earth-Orbit spaceborne Synthetic Aperture Radar (LEO SAR), Geosynchronous SAR (GEO SAR) is featured in its ultra-high orbit and ultra-long integration time. Due to the non-linear property of the ultra-long synthetic aperture, the traditional Doppler parameter calculation methods based on the linear motion model are invalid for GEO SAR. A precise analytical algorithm to calculate the fourth-order Doppler parameters for GEO SAR is proposed, analyzed and verified in this paper. We first proposed the analytical expression of fourth-order Doppler parameters for GEO SAR, and the results can be used in arbitrary ellipse orbit cases. Then, a precise fourth-order Doppler parameter calculation algorithm is developed based on the deduced formulae. Finally, the accuracy of the calculation algorithm is verified by processing real data of a drifted geostationary satellite experiment.

articleTitle: On Couple Magic Total Labellings of Graphs for Designing New Graphical Cryptographs
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: New passwords obtained by an idea of "graphical construction plus number theory" could be easy than other graphical passwords in storage space and communication of information. We show two examples for illustrating this idea, and design a new graph labelling, called (k<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, k<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>)-couple edge- magic total labelling, for realizing possibly this idea. We then present some theoretical algorithms for building graphical constructions having our labellings, and propose some new labellings and problems, such as "Every simple graph admits a 〈(k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sup>, (k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sup>〉-CEMTL", for further deep research in graph labellings and graphical passwords.

articleTitle: Opinion Target Extraction in Chinese Microblog Posts Based on Candidate Classification
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Opinion target extraction aims to find the object to which an opinion is expressed. It is helpful in getting a comprehensive understanding about public opinions on hot spot social events. In Chinese microblog posts analysis, due to the absence of words with emotional tendency (opinion words), traditional approaches relying on opinion words are not suitable. In this paper, we propose an unsupervised method based on candidate classification. Opinion target candidates are first classified according to syntactic and semantic features as well as the similarity of their head words. Then, based on similarity between sentences, an iterative algorithm is explored to extract opinion targets. Experimental results show that this approach achieves higher accuracy than state-of-the-art systems.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Study on the Characteristics of Magnetic-Gas Mixed Suspension Spherical Joint
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Nowadays, the research on maglev motor has mainly focused on the electromagnetic levitation mechanism and control strategy for the rotor. Due to the fact that the characteristics of the air gap flow-field can directly affect the static and dynamic performance of the motor, there exists a big error between the theoretical analysis and practical situation of the rotor movement. However, the bearing characteristics of air gap flow-field has not been taken into account well. Therefore, the air gap flow-field for a magnetic-gas mixed suspension spherical joint is addressed. First, the formation mechanism for a magnetic-gas mixed suspension spherical join rotating along an arbitrary axis in the three-dimensional rotating magnetic field is analyzed, and the structure of the magnetic-gas mixed suspension spherical joint is designed. Then, the static and dynamic characteristics of the motor are investigated by studying the air gap flow-field of the magnetic-gas mixed suspension spherical joint in terms of the aerodynamics. The mathematical models of the static and dynamic pressure and kinetic parameters for the air gap flow field are established. Finally, the experiment study is made to confirm the influence on the static bearing capacity and dynamic characteristics of the motor, which is generated by the air gap flow-field of the magnetic-gas mixed suspension spherical joint.

articleTitle: An Uncertain Multi-Oligopoly Model of Bertrand Type
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: When launching a new product to the market, in order to get the maximal profit, it is quite important to decide its selling price. This paper introduces a new multioligopoly model, in which the market price of a product is assumed to be an uncertain variable since it is lack of the historical data. Expected value operator and optimistic value approach are used to deal with the uncertainty in the model. Then, the optimal selling prices and the maximal profits for new products and existing products are obtained based on the proposed model. Compared with the classical multi-oligopoly model by a numerical example, it is obvious that the results in our proposed model are more reasonable.

articleTitle: Optimal Sizing of Compound Heating System Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With growing attention to energy conservation and emission reduction, solar energy is used in various fields as the basic renewable energy source and the maximum amount of energy that can be exploited in the world today is used in various fields. Therefore, a composite type combined heating operation mode based on solar collector, ground source heat pump and heat storage electric boiler in the integration is proposed, which solves the problems of traditional heating environment problems and shortcomings to a certain extent. In order to meet the load demand of the heating terminal and improve the economy of the whole heating system, combination of equipment capacity is optimized according to the existing load demand and the working characteristics of the related equipment. In this paper, the principle of the combined heating method is analyzed, and then the mathematical model and the relevant constraint conditions are set up for each component of the heating system such as solar collector, ground source heat pump and heat storage electric boiler, with the number of different components as variables, including energy, environment and economic evaluation of three indicators of a comprehensive the cost of the minimum target index. Finally, genetic algorithm is used to obtain the optimal capacity of each component in the system. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by a numerical example.

articleTitle: The Balancing of LCD Panel Assembly-Line with the Effect of Operation Elements Coordination
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a chaotic particle swarm optimization algorithm with random weights to improve the balancing of a LCD panel assembly line considering the coordination of operation elements. Based on the analysis of the constraints, the performance criteria considered are the line balancing rate and the variation of workload. The results of experiments show that the proposed model produced as good or even better line efficiency and improved the variation of workload.

Author Keywords: chaotic particle swarm optimization algorithm with random weights

articleTitle: New Nonlinear Robust Control Method Based on the State Extending and Filtering Estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the state extending and filtering robust control (SEFERC) is proposed and investigated. In the SEFERC, the uncertain nonlinear part of the MIMO is extend to the new state parameter and estimated by the nonlinear tracking filter. With the estimated value, by the direct feedback linearization (DFL) method and H∞ control method, the nonlinear system can be converted to the linear system and stabilized with the robust control theory. Taking the certain excitation and speed synthetic control system for example, simulation results show that the SEFERC can accelerate the convergence speed of the state variables and improve the excitation and speed control speed.

articleTitle: On the Evaluation of Satellite Application Technology System Based on Long-Range Precision Strike Capability
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The future warfare will be information joint. In order to achieve a high degree of integration of multiple combat forces, such as land, sea, air and rocket forces, space-based information support power should provide effective information security. In space-based information support joint operations, various satellite systems are required to cooperate with and complement each other to accomplish the corresponding tasks. The construction and evaluation of reasonable satellite application technology system based on long-range precision strike capability could provide technical support for the development of satellite application equipment. It is of great significance to improve the long-range precision strike capability for the space-based information support.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection Using 19-Layer Deep Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Pedestrian detection is one of the key technologies in automotive safety, robotic and intelligent video surveillance. Recently, deep convolutional neural networks have achieved significant effect in image classification and retrieval tasks. In this paper, we propose a novel deep convolutional neural networks model for pedestrian detection to simultaneously extract and classify pedestrian features. The proposed model is a 19 layers network which consists of 7 convolution layers, 3 pooling layers, 6 relu layers, 2 normalization layers and a classification layer. The classical back propagation algorithm is adopted to train the model based on a self-build pedestrian datasets. Then, we test the performance of the proposed deep convolutional neural networks model on public INRIA, CVC and TUD pedestrian datasets, which achieves the detection accuracies of 87.52%, 91.98% and 89.98% respectively and outperforms the state-of-the-art conventional methods.

articleTitle: Speed Interval Division of Electric Power Steering Assist Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Electric Power Steering (EPS for short) not only can provide steering power and lighten the burden of the driver's manipulation, but also can improve vehicle steering performance and driving comfort. To design the EPS assist characteristics curve, the relationship between EPS assist torque and driver's steering torque at series of speeds should be determined. And the assist torque except these speeds can be determined through linear interpolation. According to the speed interval division of EPS assist characteristics, a method is to put forward based on the steady state gain of lateral acceleration. In the curve of the steady state gain of lateral acceleration, dense speed points are set in the nonlinear range to make the curve close to linear variation, and the speed points don 't need to be set in the linear range. Finally the effect of the speed interval division for EPS assist characteristics is verified through the real vehicle test.

articleTitle: Based on the Ansoft 500kV SICSFCL Simulation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Because of its own characteristics, the Superconducting fault current limiter has a good effect on the current shock when the short-circuit fault occurs. In this paper, the effect of Saturated Iron Core Superconductive Fault Current Limiter (SICSFCL) in 500kV/3160A are discussed. Based on the analysis of the working principle of SICSFCL, build the 500kV/3150A model using Ansoft software SICSFCL, analysis of the steady state and 60kA phase short-circuit fault when working characteristics. The electromagnetic simulation and analysis show that the SICSFCL has a good effect on the short-circuit current of the 500kV power grid, which can meet the requirements of safe and reliable operation of the electrical equipment in the power grid.

articleTitle: Target Tracking Algorithm Based on Particle Filtering Fused with Mean Shift
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high computational complexity in the target tracking, this paper combines mean shift with the particle filter algorithm. The detailed process of establishing the target model is proposed. According to the results, the approach can constantly detect the exact position of target. Experimental results show that the proposed method has better performance compared with traditional approaches. The target tracking algorithm based on mean shift proposed in this paper can track well the target, and has a good effect in the case of rapid target transform and partial occlusion, which simplifies the computational complexity.

articleTitle: The Harary Index of Trees with At Most One Generalized Center Vertex
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The Harary index and Harary* index are defined as follows H(G) = Σ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k≥1</sub> γ(G, k) 1/k and H*(G) = Σ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k≥1</sub> γ(G, k), where γ(G, k) be the number of vertex pairs of the graph G that are at distance k. In this paper, the largest and smallest bound of the Harary index of trees with at most one generalized center vertex are determined. We give the formula of Harary* index of trees with at most one generalized center vertex and vertices number n, that is, H*(T) = ((n+2)(n-1))/4. And also give two conjectures with respective to Harary index and Harary* index in trees.

articleTitle: Pre-Distortion Dithering in Fractional-N Frequency Synthesisers
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A new technique is proposed to dramatically reduce the impact of fractional spurs in sigma-delta (ΣΔ) fractional-N synthesisers. The key innovation is the introduction in the bitstream generation process of carefully-chosen set of components at identical offset frequencies and amplitudes and in anti-phase with the principal fractional spurs. These signals are used to modify the ΣΔ noise shaping, so that fractional spurs are effectively cancelled. This approach can be highly effective in improving spectral purity and reduction of spurious components caused by the ΣΔ modulator, quantisation noise, intermodulation effects and any other circuit factors. Simulated and experimental results presented in this paper convincingly demonstrate this technique.

articleTitle: Formalization of Entity Dependency and Change Types
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Software change is inevitable in the process of software development. At present, there are a lot of researches on the methods of the change impact analysis, but most of them are aimed at a certain stage of the software development process, and these technologies are not suitable for other stages of software development. In this paper, based on the whole software development process, five kinds of entity dependency types and five types of change are proposed and formalized, and their properties are discussed. This paper is to provide a theoretical basis for the research of rule based change impact analysis in the software development process.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation by Hybrid Active Contour Model Using Harmonic Mean
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Edge-based models can identify the objects having solid borderline effectively, however, these models cannot appropriately segment the images with weak object borderline. On the other hand, region-based models perform better for images with unclear object borderline, however, these models cannot accurately segment images with intensity inhomogeneity. In this study, we propose a hybrid Active Contour Model (ACM) that can overcome these limitations. It is formed by substituting the edge information into region-based level set with a harmonic mean based signed pressure force function HSPF. Due to the utilization of harmonic mean intensities of the image in HSPF, the new data fitting energy can better uphold the subtle difference among the desired object intensities and that of its background that results in the effective segmentation of low contrast images. Since our proposed model has both, the region and edge information, so in comparison to traditional models, it performs better in the segmentation of images with regions of interest (ROI) having noise, indistinct borders, and intensity inhomogeneity. The proposed model is tested on noisy, real and medical images to exhibit its correctness, efficiency, and robustness. The experimental results validate that our proposed model is more efficient, rapid and correct as compared to the other related models.

articleTitle: Structure Design of Bearingless Permanent Magnet Motor
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The friction and abrasion of the traditional single degree of freedom motor have an impact on the dynamic response of the system. This paper presents bearingless permanent magnet motor structure based on permanent magnetic bearing radial bearing and axial magnetic bearing, the overall structure of the motor is also introduced in the paper. Bearingless motor with permanent magnet bearing radial bearing and bearing axial electromagnetic bearing is designed and analyzed. Then set parameters of magnetic bearing structure according to the related data, and calculate related dimensions of magnetic bearing through theoretical calculation. Using ANSYS software to calculate the magnetic bearing part of the motor, and then do some structural optimization designs by analyzing the distribution of magnetic field, magnetic flux density and air gap magnetic field.

articleTitle: Chaotic Dynamics of a Six-Dimensional Nonautonomous Rectangular Thin Plate under In-Plane Excitation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Chaotic dynamics of a four-edge simply supported rectangular thin plate under in-plane excitation are studied using the multi-degree-of-freedom Melnikov method. Based on the von Karman type equations for the geometric nonlinearity, the governing equations of motion for the four-edge simply supported rectangular thin plate under in-plane excitation are derived. The Galerkin method is employed to discretize the partial differential equations of motion to a three-degree-of-freedom nonlinear system. The three-order normal form is used to analyze the six-dimensional nonautonomous nonlinear system. Some nonlinear terms in this system have less effect than other terms. So these terms are considered as perturbation terms. The chaotic motions of the four-edge simply supported rectangular buckled thin plate under in-plane excitation are found by using numerical simulation, which further verifies the result of theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Impact of Aperture Coherence on DOA Estimation in Passive Synthetic Array
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A passive synthetic array (PSA) using a single moving sensor is formed to estimate direction of arrival (DOA). And co-prime array is used to form a virtual L-array. The impact of the passive synthetic aperture on the DOA estimation under different conditions is simulated and analyzed. Numerical simulations show that the initial time error has no obvious effect on the DOA estimation in the condition of T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>≤T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>. Nevertheless, the DOA estimation becomes more inaccurate with the initial time error increasing, in the condition of T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>≤T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>.

articleTitle: An Iterative Algorithm for Camera Pose Estimation with Lie Group Representation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: For solving camera pose problem, a novel accurate and fast pose estimation algorithm based on Lie group representation is proposed. Firstly, object function based on total space error of all feature points is built. Secondly, object function is linearized based on Lie group representation. The Jacobian matrix of camera pose is deduced and pose parameters are updated. Finally, the computation efficiency of algorithm is promoted by using Kronecker product to optimize the iteration process. Simulation and real experiments show that the proposed algorithm is able to obtain camera pose with high precision, but consumes less time compared with the existing algorithms. The proposed algorithm is capable of estimating camera pose with high precision and efficiency.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Based on Robust Control of Random Discrete Systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is a random search method based on population evolution. At present, most of the convergence and search stability of the study are using a method of analyzing deterministic systems. Although these studies have achieved fruitful results, but they ignore the randomness of the PSO algorithm which is the most important feature. The complexity and uncertainty of the algorithm is due to the existence of random factors. This paper considers the stochastic factors of the PSO algorithm, from the point of view of stochastic system robust control, a novel PSO algorithm model based on discrete stochastic control system is proposed. Then the robust controllability analysis of the model is carried out, and the robust controllable condition and control law are obtained. Based on this, a new particle swarm optimization algorithm, named particle swarm optimization algorithm based on random robust control is proposed. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of PSO Algorithm in Joint Optimization of Wind Power and Thermal Power
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Wind power is an important clean energy which is of great significance to human beings. However, due to the randomness and volatility of wind power, its integration will bring many uncertainties to the power system. If the wind power planning can not be coordinated, the wind power may not fully be sent out and absorbed. A joint optimization model of wind power and thermal power can stabilize wind power fluctuations and improve the reliability of grid connected with wind power. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to optimize the transmission line capacity and pursuit of the greatest social benefits. This paper use the MATLAB software to carry on the simulation. The particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the optimization model of combination of wind power and thermal power. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by comparing the social benefits of different transmission lines.

articleTitle: Current Loop Constant Frequency Model Predictive Control of Three Phase PWM Converter under Unbalanced Grid Condition
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The unbalanced grid condition is one of common fault in the power system, the performance of electronic equipment will reduce when the controller designer without considering the unbalanced grid input. The traditional controller design methods of three-phase pulse width modulation (PWM) converter, are based on the instantaneous power model and the double-closed loops proportional integral (PI) controller, where the positive- and negative-sequence current components are controlled separately. Thus, there are eight mutual influenced control parameters need to be tuned, it is a difficult task. In addition, the performance of PI controller will degrade when the working point changes in a large scale. In this paper, a constant frequency current model predictive control (MPC) strategy is proposed for the three-phase PWM converter under unbalanced grid condition. In this strategy, the positive- and negative-sequence predictive current values are calculated by the predictive model and the cost function of MPC is designed, the duration times of voltage vectors are produced directly by minimizing the cost function in each sector and the space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) is used, thus the constant switching frequency of system is guaranteed. The proposed method has less control parameters need to be tuned and can realize the accurately and quickly current adjustment under unbalanced grid condition, which is proved by the simulation results.

articleTitle: The Fast Forecast and Control Technology of Anti Surge on Primary Air Fan
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The reasons and process of surge of single or two parallel axial flow fans are analyzed. The control process of how to eliminate the fan surge is described. Structure diagram and principle description of the fast forecast and control loop are given aiming at the surge of primary air fan after tripping of the mill. At last, after the fast forecast and control loops are put into operation, the regulation process and result of primary air regulatory system are given especially under the scenario of one or two mills are tripped.

articleTitle: Comparison of Innovative New Technique and Traditional Endoscopic Treatment of Maxillary
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Objective: To explore the comparison of innovative new techniques and traditional endoscopic treatment of maxillary cysts. Methods: 32 cases of maxillary bone cyst patients were divided into two groups, 17 cases in the treatment group received innovative new technology in the treatment of maxillary bone cyst. 15 cases in the control group received nasal passages open window under traditional nasal endoscope in treatment. The cure rate, average hospitalization days, the average hospitalization expenses, postoperative complications and postoperative discomfort, satisfactory rate were observed and compared, respectively. Results: The patients of treatment group can be treated without hospitalization. While in the control group average hospitalization expenses, postoperative complications, postoperative discomfort, patient satisfaction were not as good as those of treatment group. Conclusion: It was more prominent of safety, effective rate and satisfaction in the treatment group than in the control group.

articleTitle: Two Approaches to Blending Spatial Weights and Temporal Weights in Calculating Spatiotemporal Autocorrelation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Since Moran's seminal paper on an index to measure spatial autocorrelation among a set of geographic objects, spatial autocorrelation coefficients have been widely used in many research and application fields. In this paper, we provide detailed reasoning for indices for measuring spatiotemporal autocorrelation. We first briefly highlight the classic Moran's Index for measuring spatial autocorrelation. Next we introduce two methods that we used to blend spatial and temporal weights. Also the simulation experiment was adopted to evaluate the difference between the two methods.

articleTitle: Reputation Computation Model for Offline Service Merchants Based on the Running Information and Ratings
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communication technology and mobile payment technology, the O2O e-commerce becomes very popular in the world. People can order services online using their smart-phone, and enjoy these services in the local brick-and-mortar service stores offline. However, with the population of O2O e-commerce, there also occur some problems such as service merchants exaggerate quality of their services, supply bad quality of services that doesn't meet their description on O2O platforms, colluding with some consumers to treat other honest consumers, so the reputation and credibility of offline merchants have gained considerable attentions. In this paper, we proposed a novel reputation model(SEREP) based the features of O2O e-commerce such as transaction number, rating time, running history of merchant, location distance between consumer and merchant and so on. The experimental results show that the SEREP reputation model can reflect the real reputation of merchants effectively, and can restrain the development of merchants who providing bad services or terrible services. The experimental results also show our SEREP model has the better ability in stand up to defaming attack while comparing with the eBay reputation system, and the CellTrust reputation system.

articleTitle: The Interoperability Test Study of Electric Vehicle A.C. Charging Spot
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The interoperability test between electric vehicle and charging equipment plays an important role on the popularization and application of electric vehicles. The principle of control pilot circuit of charging equipment is introduced firstly. Based on new national standard and the new charging interoperability test specification, the interoperability testing device of A.C. charging spot is designed and the device is used to test the interoperability test items. The test results show that the following problems exist in the interoperability test of the charging spot: (1) the potential of power supply exceeds the allowable range of ± 0.8V. (2) Charging connection control timing does not meet the standard requirements. (3) When the charging spot is under abnormal condition, it can't disconnect the AC power supply circuit within the specified time.

articleTitle: A Multidimensional Contribution-Based Service Differentiation Scheme for P2P Systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: For P2P systems, one of the key challenges is to motivate peers to contribute to the system by sharing authentic files. Since the peers differ from each other in the quantity and quality of services they provide for the system, service differentiation is necessary for the sake of fairness. In this paper, a multidimensional contribution-based service differentiation mechanism is proposed. We first introduce the definition of multidimensional contribution. Second, we propose a service differentiation mechanism to provide services for various peers. Finally, we analyze the performance of the mechanism in terms of the availability, the fairness, and the reliability by simulation. The results show that the proposed mechanism increases fairness of P2P system by clustering peers with similar contributions together and improves the effective download rate of P2P system by encouraging user to check and share authentic content responsibly.

articleTitle: Research on Data Acquisition Method for Intelligent Instruments Based on Serial Port Network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, the intelligent instrument in enterprise energy management is quickly gaining in popularity. The correct instrument information collected is the assurance of accurate analysis for energy efficiency. This paper mainly studies the method of the smart meter data collection in the energy data acquisition system, and proposes the effective measures for improving the success rate of the ammeter information collection, in order to achieve the purpose of energy conservation and emission reduction.

Author Keywords: the success rate of the ammeter information collection

articleTitle: 3D Reconstruction of Orchid Based on Virtual Binocular Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: It is normally challenging to model flowering plants, which is affected by illumination, temperature, moisture, soil, etc. To further improve the accuracy and efficiency of such 3D modeling, a 3D reconstruction method for orchid flower, based on virtual binocular stereo vision, was proposed in this paper, where two cameras with baseline and fixed focal length were applied to constitute a binocular stereo vision system. The improved Tsai two-step calibration method was also implemented to calibrate the cameras; a stereo matching algorithm based on the improved Harris corner points and regional joint was adopted to match features. Subsequently, the cloud information of 3D space points was obtained through calculation. The Delaunay triangulation method of 3D space point set was then improved, by applying the local 3D Delaunay algorithm of mesh boundary construction, to achieve 3D reconstruction based on the OpenGL platform. The simulation results suggest that, the proposed method is characterized by high operational speed, good robustness and high modeling accuracy, valuable as reference for 3D modeling of other flowering plants.

articleTitle: Research on Event-Based Updating of Spatial-Temporal Information of Multi-Source Sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Event-based information update plays an important role in the construction of smart cities. In this paper, we use the multi-source sensor data as the source. By analyzing the characteristics of different types of events, the updating rules library for the information of emergency events is established to realize the automatic updating of abnormal changes or unexpected events. Based on this, an event update based on the environment temperature change was implemented.

articleTitle: DV-Hop Algorithm for Hierarchical Processing of Average Hop Distance in UWSN
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem in the DV-hop localization algorithm that there is a large error in the process of unknown nodes to obtain the average hop distance from the beacon node. In this paper, we analyze the influence factors of the node communication radius on the average hop distance, proposed a DV-hop algorithm Based on Hierarchical Processing of average hop distance. By studying the relationship between the average hop distance and the communication radius, the unknown nodes that are one hop away from the beacon node are divided by layers so that the unknown nodes of different levels can obtain the average hop distance with relatively small error. In the stage of estimating the position of the unknown node, the algorithm calculates the unknown node coordinates by using the maximum likelihood estimation method based on the lognormal distribution through the statistical analysis of node localization error. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can significantly improve the positioning accuracy in the case of large communication radius.

Author Keywords: hierarchical processing of average hop distance

articleTitle: Research on Energy-Efficient Multi-Path Routing Protocol of WSN for Railway Environment Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: WSN for railway environment monitoring is a typical linear wireless sensor network. In order to improve the poor robustness of single path routing protocol, this paper proposes an energy-efficient multi-path routing protocol suitable for narrow strip area along the railway. In this protocol, "One-step-hop" transmission and "two-step-hop" transmission are designed to send packets with different priority level so that packets with high priority can be transmitted with fewer hops for better efficiency. Failure mechanism of this protocol further improves the robustness of the network. Results of simulations demonstrate the superiority and feasibility of this multi-path routing protocol.

articleTitle: Transient Rotation Speed Control of Power System for Hydraulic Walking Platform Based on Neural Network Structure PID
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To meet the control demand of power system in hydraulic walking platform, digital PID structure and its shortcoming is briefly analyzed, the requirement of fast regulation and control precision control for power system is presented, control algorithm with neural network structure PID is provided, its mathematic principal and calculation flow scheme is listed, load response model for gasoline engine is foundered according to physical process, a whole control system of closed-loop control is built. Control algorithm and its effect of control system is verified in experimental bench, experimental results showed that neural network structure PID algorithm effect is steady and it can meet the controlling requirement in transient speed.

articleTitle: Research on Design of the Automatic Steel Wire-Changing Cutting Device
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the current use of the cutting machine, so that it can achieve unattended and continuous work. An automatic steel wire-changing cutting device consisting of PLC control system, hydraulic push rod mechanism, sensor monitoring system and wire-changing mechanism was designed. The working principle of the fault monitoring system in the blank cutting device, the flow and the way of the signal processing of the control system, the characteristics of the hydraulic putter mechanism, and the design and working mode of the automatic wire changing mechanism were described. This device can effectively improve the efficiency of brick production, reduce production costs and enhance the safety performance of production.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Acquisition of Goldfire Platform Based on Semantic Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: We report on a new application of the Goldfire platform in knowledge acquisition. The platform constructs semantic parsing system based on the natural language processing technology, it not only realizes the logical interaction between the user and the machine, but also optimizes the question raising and answer providing process. The application results show that the structured information, both documental and non-documental, is reserved automatically and searched quickly and precisely. The Goldfire platform can extract and apply the knowledge successfully and thereby provide technical support for the advance of knowledge engineering.

articleTitle: Research on Product Modelling Design Based on Users' Perceptual Images
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Decision models for product modelling design can be optimized by utilizing the concepts of perceptual engineering technology and perceptual image. Users' perceptual cognizance's can be transformed into quantitative indexes by perceptual images, which facilitate designers to master users' multi-dimensional demands. Users' demands of functional values and emotional experience of product modelling can be understood by means of investigating the development trend of product modelling design. An optimized modelling design of an electric pencil sharpener has been taken as an example in the research to extract and match images of product modelling from the perspective of users' perceptual image experiences. Also, relevance can be established between the image and the modelling element together with transforming image languages into modelling elements for product optimization design. Based on the above research, it can not only provide a decision reference for product modelling design, but also enable users to obtain better product experiences and psychic gratification.

articleTitle: A Network Model Based on Multiple Level of Granularity
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Recent work on granular computing has introduced new notions which apply to research network structure. In this paper, we present a study of a multiple level of granularity for network. The first problem is how to model the multiple level network based on granular structure. We then propose a method of constructing a multiple level network. Compared with flooded searching path network, the proposed one is more effective.

articleTitle: A Fading Factor Unscented Particle Filter and Its Application in INS/GPS Integrated Navigation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The tracking ability and robustness of the Unscented Particle filter based on the minimum variance estimation principle are weakened when the actual data is abruptly changed. A fading factor unscented particle filter (FFUPF) algorithm is proposed in this paper, which can improve the accuracy of the unscented particle filtering and increase the tracking ability and robustness. The proposed fading factor is used to adaptively adapt the time-varying system noise. And the proposed algorithm infuses the latest observation data in the prior distribution update phase, designs the importance density function by fading factor, and makes it more close to the system status posterior probability density. Simulation has been performed by using an illustrative example and results have been provided to demonstrate the validity of the proposed algorithm as well as its improved performance over the conventional one.

articleTitle: Deep Sea Image Mosaic Based on SIFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a new technique of deep sea image mosaic based on SIFT(Scale-invariant feature transform) algorithm. The SIFT algorithm by means of the median filter to the noise processing and itself has a good ability to resist scale changes, It can effectively match the characteristics of the two deep-sea biological images in the case of parallax. In the same coordinate system, the corresponding coordinate transformation is made according to the matching characteristic points. And the neighborhood average algorithm is used to optimize the processing. The whole process of using MATLAB to achieve, The program interface is simplified to enter two images.

articleTitle: Research on Online Temperature Monitoring System Based on SAW for Intelligent Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Composed by data acquisition unit, intelligent identification unit and regulating unit, intelligent circuit breaker (ICB) plays a critical role in intelligent substations, which cuts off the fault line in a quick and accurate way when fault occurs, to ensure the stable operation of intelligent substations. Temperature is the important characteristic embodying the operating status of ICB. Aiming at the difficulty of collecting temperature data in ICB, the surface acoustic wave (SAW) based online temperature monitoring system of ICB is designed. The COMSOL software is utilized to conduct research on the temperature field distribution in ICB, the position of overheating fault is determined, and it provide theoretical basis for the intelligent identification of temperature data in the breaker. The SAW temperature sensor conducts acousticelectric signal conversion through its piezoelectric substrate, uses the changes of the transmission frequency of the SAW to reflect the changes of temperature. So the accurate collection of temperature data in ICB is ensured. This system has characteristics of strong anti-interference capacity, high transmission speed and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the Anonymous Social Network Ecology
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Anonymous social network has attracted ever-increasing attention from research community in recent years, however, it also brings some complications to ours daily life. We want to provide a reference for further regulation by addressing the problems in anonymous social network ecology. In this paper we focus our attention on summarizing the ecological status of anonymous social networks in a complete data-driven way. Specifically, we analyze text emotional tendencies, text themes and user characteristics of the anonymous networks by comparing and analyzing the data from anonymous social network application Secret and social network application Sina Weibo. And we find that the ecological status of the two applications are much different in some cases.

articleTitle: A Prediction Method of Spacecraft Telemetry Parameter Based on Chaos Theory
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Spacecraft state prediction is an important method to solve the related problems of spacecraft health management, fault diagnosis and so on. Chaos theory is widely used in electric power and machinery industries. It can describe the whole system with some parameters. It is proved that spacecraft telemetry parameters are chaotic by calculating the chaotic characteristics. Aiming at the problems of complicated spacecraft system, complicated parameters and difficult to establish accurate mathematical model, a prediction method based on phase space reconstruction is proposed. The adaptive feature extraction of spacecraft telemetry data is realized by phase space reconstruction, and the prediction of telemetry data is realized by RBF neural network and Volterra filter. The experimental results show that the proposed method has better prediction performance.

articleTitle: Dynamics Analysis of a Designed Inflatable Wing
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper explores dynamics analysis of a designed inflatable wing, the inflatable wing was designed and flight test were made to evaluate aerodynamic performance. First, a general two structural airfoils that rectangular and NACA wing based on data analysis are derived from simulation analysis. Next, the structural airfoil is extended to smooth and bumpy by comparing the pressure characteristics. The wing loading test was conducted that allowed us to predict the wing's load capabilities as high as 4-G's, which satisfied the aircraft wing loading condition. The wing flight tests were conducted, it is shown that the aerodynamic performance of skinned inflatable wing is relatively superior in comparison with the no-skinned inflatable wing.

articleTitle: A Method for Calculation of Hydrodynamic Coefficients Based on NURBS
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Accurate hydrodynamic calculation for semi-submersibles is critical to support modern rapid exploration and extraction of ocean resources. In order to speed hydrodynamic calculations, lines modeling structures were separated into structural parts and then fitted to Non-uniform Rational B-spline (NURBS). In this way, the bow and stern section lines were generated. Modeling of the intersections of the parts was then done with the universal modeling tool Patran. msc. Mesh was generated on the model in order to obtain points of intersection on the joints, and then these points were fitted to NURBS. Next, the patch representation method was adopted to generate the meshes of wetted surfaces and interior free surfaces. Velocity potentials on the surfaces were calculated separately, on basis of which the irregular frequency effect was dealt with in the calculation of hydrodynamic coefficients. Finally, the motion response of the semi-submersible was calculated, and in order to improve calculations of vertical motion, a damping term was affixed in the vertical direction. The results show that the above methods can generate fine mesh accurately representing the wetted surface of a semi-submersible and thus improve the accuracy of hydrodynamic calculations.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Modeling Research Based on the Combination of SCADA and Vibration Signals
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the vibration acceleration signals combined with SCADA data to implement condition monitoring and fault diagnosis of the key components for wind turbines. Experimental data is from a wind turbine in six months with continuous SCADA data. Then three vibration models are established using the nonlinear state estimation technique (NSET) according to the SCADA data collected during the wind turbine is working normally. The three vibration models are used to describe the complex relationship between the gearbox vibration, generator vibration, main bearing vibration and the parameters that govern its behavior. These models can also be used as a reference to help detect incipient failure. The study shows NSET is an effective and simple way to model the relationship between the gearbox vibration, generator vibration, main bearing vibration with different related parameters in a high precision. And at the same time it provides a new train of thought for wind vibration analysis.

articleTitle: Mongolia Nationality Face Recognition Based on G(2D)2PCA and SVM Classification
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the realization of national feature extraction, an improved face recognition method is proposed in order to preserve some essential local features. Gabor feature-based on bi-directional two-dimensional principal component analysis ((2D)2PCA) is applied for face images. Firstly, Gabor features of different orientations and scales are extracted by the convolution of Gabor filter bank. Secondly, dimensionality reduction of the feature space applies (2D)2PCA in both row and column. Finally, the classifier uses Support Vector Machine (SVM) to achieve our goal. Experimental results on Mongolia Nationality face database showed that the proposed method achieved better recognition accuracy compared with several other face recognition algorithms.

articleTitle: Efficient Memory Page Management for NVDIMM-Based Big Data Processing Environments
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Due to the recent computing paradigm shift from desktop to cloud environments, NVDIMM-based memory architectures for big data processing are catching considerable interest. In this paper, we present an efficient page management scheme for large-scale NVDIMM memory. The proposed architecture carefully determines the page size of a large-scale memory system such that TLB hit ratio is improved significantly without increasing the page fault ratio, thereby allowing big-data processing efficiently, which was not easy in conventional DRAM-based memory systems. The main contribution of this paper is that it proposes a new paradigm of "NVDIMM-based large memory architecture" instead of conventional "DRAM-based memory system" and presents efficient management techniques for that architecture by considering both TLB performances and page fault rates.

articleTitle: Research on Ship Power Supply Dispatching Method Based on Hierarchical Ordered Control
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Due to the arrival randomness of the ship to port, the disorderly power supply will further increase Peak-Valley difference of load in the distribution when the ship is powered by shore power, which is not conducive to the stability and economy of the grid operation. In order to solve the above problems, a distribution network dispatching architecture with distributed generation(DG) and shore power supply is proposed in this paper; in view of the distribution network scheduling system with ship power supply, a two-layer ordered power supply dispatching method is proposed, The power distribution index of the grid layer is optimal for the integrated load index to ensure the stability and economical efficiency of the power system when the ship is connected, the goal of the user layer station system is the fitness of power supply load to dispatching order, which aims to the orderly scheduling of marine power supply; At last, the power supply method is verified by the actual load data of a certain area in Liaoning, and the error of the power supply scheduling plan and the actual power supply load is less than 3%, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the Cryptographic Application Technology for Power Information System Based on DL/T 1527-2016 Technology Standard
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to enhance the security protection level of power information system, this paper has analyzed the logic structure of power information system, further studied the DL/T 1527-2016 technology specification of electric power utilization information security protection. On the basis of interpretation standards, it has researched the overall security strategy for the power information system, developed such security encryption devices as cipher machine, security encryption module, special encryption isolation gateway, etc, designed the double-deck security communication protocol which can applied for the power information system. The security performance of the security strategy, security encryption devices and the double-deck security communication protocol can meet the requirements of DL/T 1527-2016, and also can meet the security protection requirements for the current power information system.

articleTitle: A Study of Patent Analysis for Stock Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Stock price prediction is considered as one of the most challenging and important tasks. It is so complex and uncertainly, so that it is not enough to only use financial indicators for stock price prediction. As we known, patents is not only can protect the companies technologies' development and promote the advance of the core technologies, but can be used as one of the evaluation indicators to estimate the company's innovation activities. Therefore, patents have an influence on turbulence and fluctuations of companies' stock price. The aim in this study is to adopt patent and financial indicators for stock-price prediction. Thus, we collect patent and financial data as the attributes to predict the stock price by regression analysis. The experimental results show the proposed approach can accurately predict companies' stock price.

articleTitle: Safety of the SCADA Systems in Power Systems by Using Industry Protocols Data Communication
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Due to SCADA (Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition) system constitutes critical infrastructure, the disablement of its components could have a significant influence on the national security. It should be emphasized that the problem to identify and confront threats to the security of SCADA energy systems. A new method to solve this problem is proposed in this paper, based on the construction of safe industrial system architecture and analysis of the characteristics of industrial data communication protocols.

articleTitle: A Compound Search System with Infrared Detector and Millimeter Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Infrared search system is widely used in tactical warning, however the high false alarm rate severely affected the accuracy of target searching. Due to a different working principle, infrared and millimeter-wave compound search system can compensate the defect of infrared search system, reduce false alarm rates effectively. The design of the system of infrared search system and millimeter wave phased array radar is proposed. And the feasibility of the system is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Method of Predicting the Cascading Trip Accident in Power Network Considering the Operation State
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Concerning the actual status of protection in the power grid, a new strategy is proposed in this paper to evaluate the cascade tripping. Based on an operating equation of the backup relay protection, the relationship between nodal injection power and the cascade tripping is analyzed. The relationship between node injection power and cascade tripping is reconstructed by pattern recognition technology, which is employed to assess the probability of cascading failure in a power network subjected to an initial failure. A certain number of samples are obtained by simulation in IEEE39 system, which are trained and tested based on BP neural network pattern. The validity of the assessment method is verified by the calculation result.

articleTitle: Research on the Fretting Performance of Truck Crane Hoist System Based on AMESim
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: the problem of small opening jitter due to the condition of high temperature and heavy load in the winch system of truck crane was found. Firstly, in order to analysis system characteristics, the simulation model of the system is established by using AMESim software. Furthermore, the main reason which is the increasing leak amount of multi-way valve and motor that is caused by high temperature and high pressure is found by simulation. At the same time, the solution which is using the bypass oil is found. Finally, the experiments have showed that the bypass circuit of 1. 5mm damping can significantly improve the fretting of the winch system. and the problem of below jitter is solved.

articleTitle: Impact of Positive Chirp on Energy of Dispersive Waves and Stability of Solitons
