However, interestingly, the other factor multiplied to the THG conversion efficiency, which is defined as the intensity ratio of the third harmonic wave to the fundamental wave, is nearly independent of these parameters of the Gaussian pulse. Our results may offer a method to calculate the THG for the nonlinear propagation of Gaussian pulses.

articleTitle: Fragmentation Storage Model: An Efficient Privacy Protection Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the significant increase in the amount of data, outsourcing storage turns to be a trend, but there is a serious risk of data leakage. At the same time, data owners require the availability of data. As a result, outsourced storage is accompanied by the conflicts between data privacy and data availability. There are many scholars trying to outsource data by encrypting while ensuring the usability of cipher text. Traditional research methods are the searchable encryption and homomorphic encryption. However, their encryption designs are both sophisticated and inefficient. Therefore in order to get a compromise between privacy and availability, we will propose a new fragment storage model to improve data availability and security. We have compared the two time cost of fragment storage model and traditional method, and then concluded that fragment storage model can effectively reduce the time cost and guarantee the security at the same time.

articleTitle: Aspect Extraction and Aspect Terms Expansion in Chinese Reviews Using Cluster Semi-Supervised Expansion Model
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aspect extraction is one of the most important tasks for text mining. Semi-supervised methods have been proposed to solve this problem. However, the seed terms have to be given in advance in these methods. The current methods categorize the aspects without expanding more aspects terms. And most of the methods are based on English corpus, there is a great space for the research on the aspect extraction method of Chinese Corpus. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a cluster semi-supervised expansion model to obtain aspect seed terms by clustering algorithm. The purpose of aspect seed terms is to find more aspect terms. Experimental results using Chinese reviews from three types of restaurants(coffee, hotpot, barbecue) show that the proposed method is indeed able to perform the task more effectively.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Next Generation Signal Spectrum Monitoring for Satellite Broadcasting Television
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To address issues such as increasing number of broadcasting satellite transponders, signal systems becoming increasingly complex and higher requirements on spectrum monitoring in respect of real-time and all-weather coverage are required, this paper introduces a spectrum monitoring equipment based on a high-performance ARM microprocessor platform, as well as the design and implementation of a new generation of monitoring applications. Other than describing the overall structure, software architecture and key algorithms of the system, this paper also discusses in detail the center frequency of the carrier signal of the system and the calculation method for 3dB bandwidth. It has been verified that the system can complete spectrum monitoring and relevant data analysis and calculation tasks as required.

articleTitle: The Influence of Multi-Samples Rotation Vector Algorithms on Navigation Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The research focuses on the compensation effect of the equivalent multi-sample rotation vector algorithm on the errors of cone motion. The rotation vector algorithm based on both five samples which eliminates the interval error caused by sampling by using the method of the fourth order polynomial fitting and single sample are adopted to compensate the errors in cone motion. The simulation results evaluate the accuracy of five samples one by the errors of attitudes, speeds and positions, which demonstrate that the compensation effect of the five sample is better than that of single sample. So the multi-samples rotation vector algorithm has a distinct advantage on the compensation for cone motion.

articleTitle: Research on High Performance Secure Mobile Terminal Based on Offline Business Detection
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to prevent users from fake, this paper establishes a highly secure mobile terminal architecture based on ARM TrustZone, and analyzes the communication and memory sharing between trusted execution environment and common execution environment. The trust model of user operation is established, then propose a self _destruction mechanism of mobile equipment based on chip materials to detect fraudulent use, finally put forward the judgment method of mobile terminal reliability data based on detection. The experimental results show that the smaller of the threshold, the higher the frequency for user inputting fingerprint.

articleTitle: Classification of Typical Amino Acids 3D Fluorescence Spectra by 2nd Order Correction
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The intrinsic fluorescence characteristics of tryptophan, tyrosine and phenyloalanine measured with 3D fluorescence Spectrophotometer was presented in this paper. From the individual fluorescence spectra of these three fluorophores and the fluorescence spectra of one amino acids mixture sample, it can be seen that the excitation/emission wavelength of tryptophan, tyrosine and phenyloalanine locate at λex/λem=280/350nm, 275nm/303 and 260/280nm respectively, the overlapping of these three 2/3D fluorescence spectra band is obvious. Using the PARAFAC algorithm corrected by core consistency diagnostic method, 10 tryptophan, tyrosine and phenyloalanine mixed standard solutions, and one compound amino acids sample was successfully decomposed, the emission profiles, excitation profiles, central wavelengths and the concentration of the three components were retrieved with high precision.

articleTitle: The Research and Application of a Real-Time Embedded Measurement and Control System for the River Discharge
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The river discharge measurement is one of the basic projects of hygrometry; it determines the water resource utilization. However, a substantial increase in the number of hydrological site, especially for the unmanned hydrometric station brought great difficulty and caused the more workload for the Hydrologists every year. With the development of sensor technology and the data acquisition and fusion applications, it's important to build an embedded measurement and control system for the hydrological flow station. Therefore, in this paper we research and design a realtime embedded measurement and control system for the discharge measurement which can measure, store, communicate and calculate the river discharge automatically. The design of the intelligent Remote Terminal Unit (RTU) is a key step in implementation of the real-time embedded measurement and control system. The design of RTU adopts the STM32F107 as a kernel controller and the software program based on a real-time embedded operation system. This system has high accuracy and high automation level which can greatly reduce the workload of the hydrologist and promote the development of water resources informatization construction. Hydrologists can benefit from this system.

articleTitle: A New Space Radiation Suppression Algorithm for Space-Based Optical Image
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Space-based optical images are mainly affected by space radiation, sky glow background and CCD noise interference, in which space radiation noise can seriously interfere with the subsequent target detection. In this paper, we propose a space radiation interference suppression algorithm based on multi-feature, and compare with three algorithms which are commonly used to eliminate radiation noise: a Laplacian edge detection algorithm, a fast algorithm based on histogram and a rank-ordered absolute difference (ROAD) algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can quickly and effectively eliminate space radiation noise.

articleTitle: Research on Kalman Filter Prediction Method Based on Decision Tree Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The electric vehicle parameters collected by timesharing lease management platform have been accumulated increasingly, which has laid a firm foundation for large data analysis. Pretreatment technology plays an important role in the process of data acquisition. In particular, there is a risk of intervention in the process of transmitting monitoring data between two platforms. Therefore, this paper puts forward the prediction method of decision tree analysis based on Kalman filter by adopting the intervention probability curve of monitoring data and the quantitative relationship between the covariance ratio, putting the intervention probability curve interval and measurements as input to establish a regression relationship, and adding the object decision tree into the traditional Kalman filtering algorithm. This method can reduce the intervention effects, and achieve filtering and predicting function for the data collected by the main operating platform, which lays a solid technical support for big data analysis efficiently.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective Genetic Algorithm Based on Objective-Layered to Solve Network Optimization Design
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The improved algorithm based on objective layered approach is used to deal with the multi-objective network optimization problem. Based on the traditional non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm, an improved algorithm is given. In order to increase the computational efficiency, the objective layered approach is used sort the individuals of population and identify the non-inferior solution. Individuals are selected by method of loop from the first layer to the m*(1/2) layers(m is total number of layers). Two objectives, the cost and delay are considered. A few examples for the network optimization problems are used test the algorithm. The result shows the algorithm is succeed in finding Pareto solutions with higher computational efficiency.

articleTitle: A Pedestrian Re-Identification Method Based on Multi-Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Single feature of pedestrian is difficult to accurately describe the target using traditional algorithms. A new reidentification algorithm combing global features and local features with different distance metric function is introduced. First, weighted color histogram feature for whole pedestrian is extracted and combined with Bhattacharyya distance to roughly recognize targets. Then pedestrians' maximum stable color area (MSCR) of torso and legs and histograms of oriented gradients (HOG) are combined with weights for fusion feature. Finally, all obtained features are combined and compared with pedestrian original characteristics for final recognition. Pearson correlation coefficient is used as similarity measurement to finely recognize pedestrian. Experimental results show that proposed method can achieve high identification accuracy.

articleTitle: Labeled LDA-Kernel SVM: A Short Chinese Text Supervised Classification Based on Sina Weibo
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: At present, it is a great challenge that solving high-dimension and text sparsity problems in short text classification. To resolve these problems, this paper proposes a method which takes the correlation between lexical items and tags before completing Latent Dirichlet Allocation(LDA) topic model. Meanwhile, this paper adjusts parameters of Support Vector Machine(SVM) to find the optimal values by K-fold cross validation. Besides, using kernel SVM as classifier, we successfully categorize labeled short Chinese text documents. Comparing with other two conventional methods k-Nearest Neighbor and Decision Tree of short text classification, the experimental results show that our method outperforms them on classification accuracy, precision, recall and F-measure.

articleTitle: Two Algorithms for Active Vibration Control of a Flexible Cantilever Beam
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The active vibration suppression with piezoceramic actuators has been paid more and more attention to for the flexible structures, but there are still some key problems to be solved to ensure the effectiveness and feasibility of the active vibration control. This paper presented the experiment results of the control results with the state feedback pole assignment and the positive position feedback respectively. Firstly, the control system of a flexible aluminum cantilever beam with bonded piezoelectric actuators was modeled in theory and with experiment validation. The resonance frequency and the damping ratio of the first-order mode of the beam were calculated by a coarse identification and a fine identification. Then, the two control algorithms, the state feedback pole assignment and the positive position feedback, were implemented to control the first-order mode of the beam vibration actively. The control performances of the algorithms were compared. The experiment results show that the positive position feedback is better both in the control speed and in the attenuated amplitude than the state feedback pole assignment.

articleTitle: Detection of Oil Spill and Look-Alike from SAR Imagery Based on Ontology and Kernel Fuzzy C-Means
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Oil spills is a major threat to ocean ecosystems. The capability of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) sensors to detect oil spills over the sea surface is established and proven. Oil spills appear as dark spots in SAR images. However, dark formations can be caused by a number of phenomena (e.g., manmade actions, geological conditions, and meteorological and hydrological effects). The current researches aims to distinguish oil spills or look-alikes. The methods include three main parts, dark formation detection, feature extraction, and classification. To further improve the accuracy and efficiency of SAR image segmentation in the detection of marine oil spill, this study presents a new framework for oil spill and look-alike classification based on kernel fuzzy C-means (KFCM) and ontology. Ontologies are employed to model semantic concepts about shape, existence time, forming reason, and texture. Pre-classification can be performed by matching each region with the concepts of ontology. Once the needed dark formations have been selected, KFCM algorithm is used for classification. Experiment results show that this method performs well.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Estimation Method for SOC of Lithium Batteries in Electrical Vehicles Considering Vehicle Operating Condition Recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Owing to its advantages of being closed-loop and online as well as small memory storage length, adaptive extended Kalman filter (AEKF) based state of charge (SOC) estimation method for lithium batteries in electric vehicles (EVs) has been widely used. However, EVs often have to operate under complex conditions, such as sudden acceleration and deceleration. Under the strong nonlinear input, the AEKF based method can not track the true SOC rapidly. In order to solve this problem, an estimator for EVs operating condition is used to identify the working conditions in this paper, including stable condition and non-stationary condition. AEKF based method is used to estimate SOC when EVs run under stable condition, and look-up table based method is employed to estimate SOC in case of the non-stationary condition. The experimental results show that the hybrid estimation method proposed in this paper has higher SOC estimation accuracy and better convergence rate.

articleTitle: Error Analysis on Digital Metering Devices of New Generation of Intelligent Substation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Digital metering devices is taking important place in new generation of intelligent substation, but the method to analysis their error is not fit to its new characteristics. Aiming to improve the accuracy of error analysis result, this paper analyzed the error source of digital metering devices, and attempted to acquire how much do these influences affects the metering accuracy of digital metering devices in new generation of intelligent substation, furthermore, this paper did analysis on network abnormal event to find the relationship between network communication and metering error, finally simulating experiments were done to confirm the validity and effectiveness of research result.

articleTitle: Exponential Stability of Switched Positive Linear Systems without Stable Subsystems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, exponential stability of switched positive linear systems (SPLSs) composed of all unstable modes is first investigated. Through minimum dwell time and fast average dwell time (ADT) approach, sufficient conditions of exponential stability of SPLSs without stable subsystems are derived. The main idea is to utilize the decrement of energy functions caused by switching to compensate the increment caused by unstable modes. Through a time-schedule multiple linear copositive Lyapunov function (MLCLF) constructed in continuous-time contexts, computable sufficient conditions of exponential stability are presented in the form of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). It is shown that the switching signals which can exponentially stabilize the SPLSs are required to be confined by minimum dwell time and maximum fast ADT. A numerical example is given to show the effectiveness of the results.

articleTitle: Security System of ETC Internet Service
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Internet of ETC is a problem that current technology development and users needs to be solved urgently. Furthermore, the risk of Internet access to traditional industry is the main direction currently being explored and studied across all trades. This paper will propose a set of Internet service security system.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Electronic Payment Protocols Based on Quantum Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Electronic payment protocols play a vital role in electronic commerce to ensure the security of transaction process. Current electronic payment protocols based on complex mathematical problems will be vulnerable facing a quantum computer. In order to enhance the security against quantum computers, quantum cryptography is introduced into electronic payment protocols. Although the quantum cryptography is claimed to be unconditionally secure, Logical defects are still likely to cause serious problems. We introduced formal analysis to verify the security of electronic payment protocols based on quantum cryptography. Formal analysis methods can discover the vulnerabilities of protocols and help to improve the security of protocols. In this paper, we analyze an electronic payment protocol based on quantum cryptography and the result shows that the protocol is not secure even adopting unconditionally secure quantum cryptography. We found that both the accountability and fairness of the original protocol are not satisfied. Then we proposed an improved protocol to meet the requirement of accountability and fairness and verified it through formal analysis method.

articleTitle: Mixed-Integer Programming Model for Two-Dimensional Non-Guillotine Bin Packing Problem with Free Rotation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Two-dimensional bin packing problem (2BPP) is a classical problem in operations research and has been extensively investigated in the past years. The 2BPP can be classified according to choices of the orientation (fixed orientation or 90 degrees rotated) and the cut type (guillotine or non-guillotine cut). Many mathematical models and solution methods have been proposed for the problem. However, due to the difficulty in representing constraints, no exact mathematical model is presented for the two-dimensional non-guillotine bin packing problem with free rotation (2BPP-NR). In this paper, we present two Mixed-integer programming (MIP) models for the 2BPP-NR. Computational experiments are conducted on random problem instances and comparative analyses of the proposed models are presents. Results show the Model II outperforms the Model I in both number of constraints and computational time.

articleTitle: A Dual Method for Uniform Noise Removal Base on L[infinity] Norm Constraint
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In mathematics, the problem of uniform noise removal can be formulated as a minimization problem with L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> norm constraint. The key to solve the minimization problem is to find an efficient scheme to handle the numerical difficulty due to the property of the non-differentiability of L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> norm. In this paper, the dual problem for minimization problem with L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> fitting is shown and the solution of the dual problem is obtained by applying forward-backward splitting method. Our experimental results show the proposed method is efficient.

articleTitle: Enhancement Method for Infrared Dim-Small Target Images Based on Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A new method based on rough set theory is put forward for enhancing infrared dim-small target images. Rough set is firstly utilized to separate image pixels according to the differences of gray scale and gradient among targets, background and noises. Then different processing for different pixel sets is done, so infrared dim-small targets can be enhanced perfectly, and at the same time the background and noises are restrained partly. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed enhancement method with rough set.

articleTitle: Adding Fuzzy Lookup Table Type Method to the Comparable Milling Machining Control Design Based on MAT LAB/SIMULINK
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The most effective way to improve the simulation results is to improve the model itself, different methods established to check the model comparability. Because of the Time-varying, nonlinearity and complexity of the machining process, the traditional PID control has been unable to meet the requirements, which are being high-speed and high-precision, the most active solution methods had been investigated by adding an advanced controller's method. The idea to establish a comparable model witch able to accept this addition is a big deal, therefore, this paper aims to create a milling control process model using the MAT LAB/SIMULINK software to generate real milling machining equations, and giving it appropriate processing parameters. To insure that the simulating results are comparable, first the process will be modelled in the MATLAB software to test the step response under various parameters. Then, I will show how to add a Look-up table fuzzy control method step by step to the established model, using the same idea to cut a work piece example mentioned in some previous published papers. Finally, comparing this method with other work results using Fuzzy Interface Mamdani Style added to the same model witch I did in the previous paper.

articleTitle: Measuring Vortex-Induced Vibration with Hot Wire in Wind Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Long cantilever stings that support aerodynamic models in wind tunnels are a potential source of vibration problems which would damage test data quality, many documents use the methods of setting acceleration sensors on model to measure vibration of model-sting system, but setting sensors on little scale model is hard to realize, and sensors could interfere with flow field around the model. For purpose of reducing flow field interference, a method of hot wire probe measuring wake to acquire vibration parameters of model is tried, this way is easy to realize for little scale model. At the same time, methods of accelerator signal frequency domain filtering and frequency domain integration are used to acquire vibration model parameters of model-sting for comparison with data of hot wire, this method could improve the SNR of effective signal. Using method of accelerator signal power spectrum analysis, three order vibration frequencies of 31.1Hz¡120.9 Hz and 221.4Hz of the system are acquired. Using method of frequency domain filtering and frequency domain integration, the vibration mode and node of the system are acquired. Using method of hot wire measuring wake, vortex shedding frequencies of 31.1Hz and 124.1 Hz, and the model buffet boundary are acquired. Experiment results show that, the method of hot wire measuring model wake vortex shedding frequency for analysis of aircraft model vibration, is convenient for little scale model test, is a practical method for vortex-induced vibration measurement.

articleTitle: Monitoring Nyiragongo Volcano Using a Federated Cloud-Based Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Current Nyiragongo Volcano observatory systems yield poor monitoring quality due to unpredictable dynamics of volcanic activities and limited sensing capability of existing sensors (seismometers, acoustic microphones, GPS, tilt-meter, optical thermal, and gas flux).The sensor node has limited processing capacity and memory. So if some tasks from the sensor nodes can be uploaded to the server of cloud computing then the battery life of the sensor nodes can be extended. The cloud computing can be used both for processing of aggregate query and storage of data. The two principal merits of this paper are the clear demonstration that the Cloud Computing model is a good fit with the dynamic computational requirements of Nyiragongo volcano monitoring and the novel optimization algorithm for seismic data routing.The proposed new model has been evaluated using ArduinoAtmega328 as hardware platform, Eucalyptus/Open Stack with Orchestra-Juju for Private Sensor Cloud connected to some famous public clouds such as Amazon EC2, ThingSpeak, SensorCloud and Pachube.

articleTitle: A Water-Filling Theory Based Power Control Scheme in Two-Tier Cellular Network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To meet the imperative need for ubiquitous mobile communication, the infrastructure of the next-generation mobile system, i.e. 5G, is developing toward a densely distributed cellular network with multiple tiers of base stations and access technologies serving users with different mobility styles and variant bandwidth demands. Therefore, strategy of power control and interference mitigation is becoming to be a more important issue. This paper provides a mobile station power control algorithm within a 5G two-tier cellular infrastructure. The algorithm is based on Water-filling theory and is aimed at maximizing system capacity of the network. Simulation results indicate that, compared to the traditional power control scheme which simply aimed at obtaining a fixed target SINR, the proposed scheme improves system capacity based on an equivalent or even lower power consumption.

articleTitle: Analysis and Synchronization of a Novel Memristor Hyper-Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this work, a new hyper-chaotic system based on memristor is proposed and the anti-synchronization is demonstrated. Through the analysis of the system behaviors, including the stability of equilibrium set, Lyapunov exponents and phase portraits, it demonstrates the proposed system is a new hyper-chaotic system with the features of infinite equilibrium points and complex dynamic characteristics. Besides the anti-synchronization of the memristor hyper-chaotic system is realized. It is proven that the dynamics of the anti-synchronization error is globally and asymptotically stable based on the Lyapunov stability theory. Numerical simulations are given in the end. It provides the theoretical foundation for the aspects of security communication and image encryption.

articleTitle: Application of Real-Time Load Control Decision Technology Based on User's Interruptible Load
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: When serious HVDC transmission fault happens, Emergency load shedding measures will be taken. In order to achieve the precise load shedding, it proposes a real-time load control decision technology based on user's interruptible load. Some key technologies involved in the process of control decision are studied just like quick response, precise control, stability control security. Designed the mechanism used in the decision such as user dynamic sequence table, decision preparation, load cycle supplement, failure switch list and so on. Finally, the application scene of real-time control decision is simulated. The real-time control decision technology proposed in this paper has been applied in the large scale supply and Demand friendly interactive system, and realized the real-time precision control ability to user's interrupt the load after receiving the load shedding instruction.

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Analysis of Carbonate Outcrop in South America with Response of Global CO2 Sink
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In current research, carbon cycle for global change are mechanically treated. Generally, climate-physics systems and biological processes were usually as short-time scale, fossil fuel-forming were considered as medium-time scale, and all geological processes (including karstification) were treated as long-term scale. As a result, the influences from geological action were neglected in the process of actual observation and test, which is contrary to the theory of earth science system. Therefore, more effort should be focused on improvement of carbon cycle for global change as well as the redivision of scale action. Most carbonate rocks are susceptible to karstification, although not all are well karstified. Thus the area of carbonate rock outcrop provides an upper limit on the area of exposed karst terrain. In this work, ArcGis software was employed to extract the geological data. Furthermore, the global change in South America carbonate outcrop area were analysed according to the temperature, rainfall and forest area from 1989 to 2010. The results show that impact of temperature on the change of carbonate outcrop area is not obvious. As forest area slightly reduced, the less the reduction of rainfall is, the less the increase is for carbonate outcrop area in Venezuela, Argentina and Bolivia. In addition, GEM-CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> model was used to estimate the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> sink of South American carbonate outcrops, which have increased 2.27 million tons.

articleTitle: An FPGA-Accelerated Doppler Parameters Estimation Engine for Real-Time Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate an achievable implementation of Doppler parameters estimation engine. Taking advantage of FPGA, a highly parallelized and reconfigurable structure with a unified calculation is adopted. We build a prototype using single off-the-shelf Xilinx XC6VSX315T FPGA to verify the proposed method in a 16384 ×16384 SAR imaging process. The experiment result can achieve more than 20x time speedups over CPU-based solution, and the FPGA hardware resources can be balanced.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method for Charging Facilities Siting
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Due to the important roles in relieving energy crisis and environmental pollution, electric vehicles have been developed greatly. Charging facilities are linked to electric vehicles closely, and the accuracy of the charging area and scale affect their applications to a great extent. Based on the transaction data of the charging facilities in a city of northern China, this paper calculates the occupancy rate of these charging facilities and divides them by box plot. Then, we choose the data such as the surrounding environment of the charging facilities, the parking charging standard and the spatial location as well as the proportion of the own pile within 3km for analysis of variance. We found that the surrounding environment and the proportion of the own pile have significant effect on occupancy rate of charging facilities. Finally, according to the results of analysis of variance, the decision tree classification model of charging facilities is established. The results demonstrate that the model can identify the idle facilities.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Payoff Interplay between Local Project Officers and Village Cadres during Rural Development Project Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper examines the payoff interplay between multiple stakeholders during rural development project evaluation. Drawing from the game theory, it analyzes the factors that influence the payoffs of local project officers and village cadres and the strategy they adopt by building mathematical models for the payoffs of different stakeholders and seeking the Nash-Equilibrium solution and the analytical equilibrium solution. It concludes with strategic choices for local project officers and village cadres and reveals the collusion between them for benefits, which hampers the evaluation on project quality and undermines the interests of the sponsors and the beneficiaries of the projects.

articleTitle: An Improved Multi-Keyword Ranked Search over Encrypted Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Documents encrypted on the cloud servers can improve security, it also brings about a challenging question for secure query. We use the vector space model (VSM) to obtain the similarity of the documents. In this paper, we use a secure method to support multi-keyword parallel query, which the improved multi-tree [1] can storage the vector value and query similar to the linear. The advantage of using multiple trees is to improve the efficiency of dynamic update (insertion, deletion, inquire) and support parallel query and multi-keyword query. In order to further improve the efficiency of the query, we use the naive Bayesian to classify the documents. Based on the user's query keywords have relevance, we can make similar documents stored in the multi-tree more intensive with naive Bayesian classification. In order to strengthen the privacy query, the article [2] proposed two kinds of security index model, one is known cipher model, the other is known background model. In known background model, we randomly add some vocabulary to the hash table to resist statistical attack. By applying our improved index tree, we can achieve near-linear query and dynamic operation of the documents, which improve the operability and take into account the efficiency and accuracy of the query. The security analysis and experiments verify the security and efficiency of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Systhesis Decision of Level of Repair Analysis on Invalid Parts
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As the determination of level of repair is affected by kinds of factors in reality, there are many difficulties in operation. Therefore, it is necessary to carry out the systhesis decision of level of repair analysis for this problem. On the basis of the existing research results, this paper puts forward a systhesis decision-making method based on the decision-making flow, which is integrated quantitative and qualitative methods, taking the aeronautical equipment as an example. The improved TOPSIS method is used to solve the constructed scheme, and the optimal scheme is finally determined, which lays the foundation for the optimal configuration of spare parts.

articleTitle: Phase Center Variation Modification on BDS High-Precision Baseline Solution
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This study establishes a new absolute PCV field measurement method according to synchronized dual antenna theory. The new method is relatively simple compared with traditional PCV measurements and takes comprehensive errors source into consideration. Focusing on this new model, this paper carries out several experiments to verify the validity and accuracy of this method. The accuracy of average baseline solution was improved by 15% after the modification of PCV parameters on single-difference baseline values. In addition, this study analyzes the influence of multipath effect and navigation files on PCV accuracy. Through the baseline solution accuracy analysis of different constellations of BDS using PCV and under different environments, it is proved that PCV has significant influence on BDS high-precision solution and the model established in this paper in verified.

articleTitle: The Spatio-Temporal Data Modeling and Application Based on Graph Database
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Traditional spatio-temporal data model (STDM) is based on relational database, it is hard to convert problem domain model to relational model, which result in complicated query and low expansibility. In this regard, we propose the spatio-temporal data model based on graph database. The data model integrates TGIS's three key elements: space, time and attributes, and expressed spatio-temporal characteristics of TGIS explicitly. Finally, this paper gives a particular description of logistics distribution route optimization. Experimental results show that the model is proved to be appropriate for expressing the spatio-temporal process of world.

articleTitle: Research of Wireless Sensor Network Data Fusion Technology Based on RMSMTV
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: At present, the existing trust protocols and models in the trust mechanism of the wireless sensor network have several problems such as one-sided reputation assessment, avoidless malicious evaluation from the nodes, and overfull subjective factors in the evaluation process. In order to solve these problems, a Reputation Model based on Similarity Measure of Trust Value in wireless sensor networks(RMSMTV) is presented. In this model, neighbor nodes of the target node are fully considered, and the reputation assessments of each node are collected, thus the objectivity and accuracy of the reputation assessment result are insured. Further more, in regard to the problems that the controlled nodes, especially excellent reputaion nodes, lunch attacks, RMSMTV uses fuzzy similarity theory to measure the commendatory reliability of the nodes' trust value, identify the abnormal trust value and cut down the authority. As a result, the attacks can be suppressed effectively, and the syncretic outcome will be more accurate.

articleTitle: Characterization of Methanol in White Spirits Based on Two-Dimensional Infrared Correlation Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The aim of present work is to develop an innovative and alternative method for the identification and quantification of methanol in white spirits based on twodimensional (2D) infrared spectroscopy. Firstly, for the identification and quantification of methanol in white spirits, 19 white spirits samples adulterated with different levels of methanol (0.1% to 10%) were prepared. And, the Fourier transform one-dimensional (1D) infrared spectra of all samples were measured at room temperature. Secondly, spectral characteristics of white spirits adulterated with methanol were studied by 1D infrared spectra and 2D infrared correlation spectra. Then, the origin of 1020 cm-1 peak of methanol was verified in terms of the existence or not of cross peaks in synchronous and asynchronous 2D infrared correlation spectra. Finally, The calibration curve was established based on the auto-peak intensity at 1020 cm-1 in synchronous 2D infrared spectra and methanol concentration in white spirits. The coefficient of determination was 0.995. The proposed method can provide a new and fast detection technique of methanol in white spirits, and also be applied to other food safety detection areas.

articleTitle: Research on End-to-End Delay Variation Feature Extraction Method for Nonstationary Network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Traditional tomography methods are based on a single statistical feature(such as delay difference, variance, etc.) of network as a measure of the shared path length, but the single statistics don't reflect the time-varying of network performance parameters. In this paper, the packet group detection model is used to obtain the end-to-end delay curve in the non-stationary network for the first time. Then wavelet packet decomposition is used to extract non-stationary features of end-to-end delay variation.

articleTitle: Research on High-Precision Extraction of Phase Difference Change Rate in Single Observer Passive Location
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Airborne Single Observer Passive Location has the characteristics of mobility and a wide range impaction, while location method basing on phase difference change rate also has the characteristics of getting a quick location with high precision. Studying the Kalman Filter (KF) applied in Airborne Single Observer Passive Location, it analyzes the principle of the position method basing on phase difference change rate, and introduces the filtering principle and the filtering process of the KF algorithm. The simulation results show that, KF algorithm used in Airborne Single Observer Passive Location has an accurately positioning and rapid convergence.

articleTitle: A Facial Features Matching Method with Age Robustness Based on SIFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Facial change with age is always a problem in facial features matching for photos of ID cards. In order to solve this problem, a novel facial features matching method based on SIFT algorithm is proposed. Inspired by attention mechanism of the visual system, the facial features focuses on the four sub regions (left eye, right eye, nose and mouth), ignoring other unimportant regions, and different weights are used to each region according to the contribution of each region to matching accuracy. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the influence that age change lead to a sharp decline in matching accuracy, and this algorithm can significantly reduce the time of features matching.

articleTitle: The Research and Application on CO Adsorption Experiment of Different Metamorphic Coal under the Constant Temperature and Pressure
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to find the relationship between coal metamorphic and adsorption of Carbon Monoxide(CO) and reveal the source of CO in mines. Through preparation and industrial analysis of coal samples, mercury injection experiment and analysis of different metamorphic grade coal samples, to analysis the impaction on coal metamorphic grade of CO adsorption. Research shows with the increase of coal metamorphic grade, coal adsorption quantity of CO has a trend that increase at first and then decrease. The conclusion of this paper is that coal adsorption quantity of CO has a positive correlation with the sum of microporous coal samples and pore volume of coal samples and it is helpful to reveal the source of CO in mines.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Embedded Home Server Based on SQLite in Smart Home System
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Due to the high cost and high power consumption problem of the present smart home server, we designed and implemented a home server based on embedded system, mainly developed by ARM11 for a hardware platform, Linux system for operating system, SQLite database and BOA server for a software platform. The home server has successfully implemented the network communication, SQLite database peration and Web monitoring function by transplanting the SQLite database, the BOA server and the CGIC library to the ARM-Linux platform. The test results show that the home server can be successfully applied in the smart home system.

articleTitle: Design of Two-Wheeled Self-Balance System Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The proposed system is a self-balancing system based on STM32F103 using Cortex-M3 core. Firstly, MPU6050 and hall encoder are utilized to measure angle and speed respectively. These sensors can meet the requirement of real time. Then, digital filtering algorithm and kalman algorithm are adopted to process the digital singal. Finally, the stepping motor is used to drive the whole system. The experimental results show that our system can achieve self-balancing efficiently. Furthermore, it can finish attitude correction and speed control effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Resonant Magnetic Coupling Wireless Power Transmission with Intensifier
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A novel approach is presented for improving the performance of a series-series magnetic coupled resonance wireless power transmission system by adding an intensifier coil between the emitter and receiver. The best position of the intensifier is determined and a prototype is designed and tested. Using an intensifier coil at the optimal intermediate position between emitter and receiver coils of 12 cm radius located 30cm apart increases power transfer from less than 2W to 8W and raises power transmission efficiency from 10% to 60%.

articleTitle: Design on Security Communication Protocol of Electricity Acquisition Terminal Based on the Password Techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Based on fresh random challenge response authentication and key agreement, access control, priority control mechanisms, this paper puts forward a security protection communication protocol to guarantee the data transmission security of electricity acquisition terminal and the acquisition host. From the angle of attack detection, this proposed protocol was proved that can resists replay attack, counterfeit attack and information intercepted attack, and can ensure the safety of the electricity power acquisition system overall.

articleTitle: A Cyber Crime Investigation Model Based on Case Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the recent development of Information Communication Technology (ICT) in every aspect in our life, cyber crime is also expanding and cyber crime investigation is maturing into a more challenging issue which needs to be confronted. In the early stages of the digital investigation of cyber crime case, digital evidence is inadequate, decentralized and fragmented. In this paper, we present a cyber crime investigation model based on case characteristics, to help determine investigation orientation and reduce investigation area. Firstly, purifying and filtering the digital evidence collected, classification and acquirement of event sets are accomplished. Secondly, a method of imperfect induction is applied to analyze the event sets and construct one or more premises, and combining with the case characteristics extracted from the legal requirements, inference and its reliability valuation are given. Finally, through a network pyramid sales case analysis, the initial practice shows the model is feasible and has a consulting value with cyber crime investigation.

articleTitle: A Pi-Calculus Based Context-Aware Model for Web Service Composition
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Formal methods are effective ways to model and verify software system. To Describe and verify Web services by formal method is considered as an important research field. Guaranteeing the correctness of Web services composition is indispensable for enhancing the value of services. Pi-calculus is a kind of process algebra which can be used to model asynchronous concurrent communication network. A Picalculus based context aware model for Web service composition is presented. Web services behavior are described and modeled based on Pi-calculus in this paper. Finally, a case study is presented and the validity of composition model is verified.

articleTitle: Research on SAW Sensors in TPMS
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the performances of several tire temperature and pressure sensors in Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) were analyzed, and the corresponding IC and MEMS core technology in R&D of the active and passive sensors was studied. It is pointed out that the passive wireless sensor chips based on the surface acoustic wave (SAW) is the development direction in automotive safety products. In addition, this paper analyzed the principle, working process and the development of SAW sensors in recent two decades. As to the current international technical barriers, the patent technologies of the SAW sensor were presented, and the international competition and cooperation were discussed. Finally we draw the conclusions that in order to break the technical barriers of European and American automobile trade, it is quite necessary to develop the core technology of SAW sensors, together with the independence, resources integration, business risk control and the perfection of patent law, due to the huge economic benefits of the SAW sensors.

articleTitle: Locpart: A Latency Optimized Cache Partitioning for Cloud Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As continual evolution of virtualization technology and cloud computing paradigm, modern data centers consolidate various application to run with less servers. However, co-locating applications is challenging, especially for mixed workloads of both latency-critical and batch programs. It is required to address the unpredicted performance and quality-of-service (QoS) due to contention for the shared last-level caches (SLLC). In this paper, we present a novel latency optimized cache partitioning policy, Locpart, which requires neither hardware modification nor complicated software design. Locpart prioritizes latency-critical services over batch workloads on generating cache partitioning schemes with conservative allocation to gurantee QoS. At the same time, Locpart seeks to balance the rest cache ways among the workloads to achieve a maximum global performance. Evaluation with workloads mixes of emerging latency-critical as well as conventional batch programs show that Locpart guarantees the QoS and improves the global system performance in parallel significantly.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Protection of Brocade Technique Based on Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of Chinese society and the blend of eastern and western cultures, Chinese minority culture has been greatly affected. Due to the poor protections by traditional methods, such as pictures and videos, minority techniques are endangered. By taking advantage of virtual reality technology and using creative thinking and innovative method, the digital protection of brocade technique of Yunnan Dai nationality was discussed. First, 3D models of Yunnan Dai brocades and tools were made. Second, database was formed. Third, 3D virtual platform of Yunnan Dai brocade technique was established. Fourth, Unity 3D was used to show the platform. At the same time, somatosensory recognition technology was used to realize the interaction between users and platform, which makes the show more vivid and more comprehensive. Finally, the purpose of digital protection of Yunnan Dai brocade technique can be achieved.

articleTitle: Field Inspection Technology and Application of AC Charging Pile Based on Industrial Computer
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a portable field inspection device based on industrial control computer is developed, which is used to carry out electrical performance test, charging interoperability test and electric energy metering test of singlephase or three-phase AC charging pile. The paper describes the field inspection principle, system structure test process and technical parameters of the device, and finally verify the performance of the device through the practical application, which can meet the needs of field inspection.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Location Method in Small Current Grounding System Based on Active Protection
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The fault location method of big current grounding system is simple, we set fast switch device in the neutral point, through the switch the small current grounding system can transform into a large current grounding system, combined with fault impedance method we get the fault location method in small current grounding system based on active protection. Then we make simulation research on three factors which affect the active positioning method of this paper are as follows: transition resistance, load fluctuation and fault distance. The simulation results identify the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Study of the Robot Loading/Unloading Unit Based on the Optimized Automatic Verification System of Electric Meters
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Based on the study of the robot loading/unloading unit in automatic verification system of electric meters, this paper proposes almost efficient assigning method of robot loading/unloading. The established efficient model reasonably assigns the meter-gripping and box-gripping to the loading/unloading robots, designs the robots gripping device combined with vacuum discs and pneumatic fingers, which realizes the compatible gripping of the turnover boxes and electric meters without changing robot gripping devices, and spares the "gripping device changing" step, which simplifies the whole operative procedure. Therefore the problem is solved of the lower efficiency of the robot loading/unloading unit compared with that of the whole production-line automatic operation of the electric meters. This study can greatly increase the operative efficiency of robot loading/unloading unit. This design is easy to be spread with an obvious improving effect of highly enhanced operative efficiency of the whole system.

articleTitle: Exponential Stabilization for Delayed Memristive Fuzzy Cellular Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper is focused on a new class of cellular neural networks with memristive, fuzzy logic, time-varying delays and general activation functions. The dynamic analysis in the paper employs results from the theory of differential equations with discontinuous right-hand side as introduced by Filippov. Some sufficient conditions in terms of algebraic criteria are presented such that the proposed system is global exponential stabilization. The model based on the memristor in this paper provide a wider scope for the design of neural networks. In addition, the results here are easy to verify and they complement the earlier publications. Finally, numerical simulations illustrate the effectiveness of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Initial Alignment of Strapdown Inertial Navigation System with the Aid of Doppler Velocity Log
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an initial alignment approach for strapdown inertial navigation system with external information from Doppler velocity logs, aimed at improving navigated accuracy. Based on Kalman filtering theory, we make an analysis comparison between two different error models according to simulation results. Then, we respectively discuss the effects that measured velocity errors, height channel and different models do to the initial alignment accuracy of strapdown inertial navigation system. The experimental results show that the proposed approach can not only apply to initial alignment of height channel within short time, but also determine the velocity and position with satisfied precision.

articleTitle: Multi End-Hopping Modeling and Optimization Using Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: End-hopping is an effective component of Moving Target Defense (MTD) by randomly hopping network configuration of host, which is a game changing technique against cyber-attack and can interrupt cyber kill chain in the early stage. In this paper, a novel end-hopping model, Multi End-hopping (MEH), is proposed to exploit the full potentials of MTD techniques by hosts cooperating with others to share possible configurable space (PCS). And an optimization method based on cooperative game is presented to make hosts form optimal alliances against reconnaissance, scanning and blind probing DoS attack. Those model and method confuse adversaries by establishing alliances of hosts to enlarge their PCS, which thwarts various malicious scanning and mitigates probing DoS attack intensity. Through simulations, we validate the correctness of MEH model and the effectiveness of optimization method. Experiment results show that the proposed model and method increase system stable operational probability while introduces a low overhead in optimization.

articleTitle: Space Energy Internet System
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Global Energy Internet is one of the hottest research fields recently. It is a further development and enhancement of the smart grid system. However, the energy Internet is different from the smart grid in several aspects. Energy Internet is a new type of ecological energy system that is integrated with traditional energy system when the information has evolved into a new means of production, especially with the introduction of the concept of energy micro-grid and it change the system and architecture of the traditional smart grid. Energy micro-grid is a distributed energy network system that can achieve efficient energy supply and consumption. In this paper we present a new concept of energy micro-grid such as space energy Internet system. The concept of solar power station is explained and the definition and connotation of space energy Internet system is described. The technique of the distributed satellite constellation energy network architecture, wireless energy transmission technology, energy and information integrated transmission and joint scheduling technology will be discussed thoroughly. We also elaborate some design challenges and solutions of the key technologies for space energy Internet system. These studies lay the theoretical and engineering foundations for the future space energy Internet system.

articleTitle: Sea Ice Drift Tracking with a MCC Method of Automatically Acquiring Features
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Features of sea ice is often not obvious, and to delineate feature areas manually would limit the effect of MCC method for tracking sea ice drift. This study focuses on automatic selection of feature regions. First, an object-oriented segmentation method, which is based on the level iterative merging algorithm, is used for the sea ice areas. Then the corner points are obtained as the candidate feature points, and some obscure candidate feature points are eliminated by a proposed removing rule. Finally, these feature points are used to monitor the sea ice drift based on the MCC method of automatically acquiring features. Based on sea ice data set in the Bohai Sea from Geostationary Ocean Color Image (GOCI) satellite, the results show that this proposed method can improve the efficiency of the MCC method, and the experimental results are also verified with a back-matching method.

articleTitle: Extract of Combustion Characteristic Information and Its Feedback Establishing in Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: According to requirement of closed-loop combustion control and combustion process character in diesel engine, cylinder pressure is used to analyze combustion condition character, pressure difference method is introduced into combustion pressure resolution, combustion intensity and combustion phase and releasing heat are presented to describe combustion condition, the whole combustion character is illustrated with multi-parameter in pressure difference curve, all kinds of parameter are briefly analyzed, combustion commence point, maximal burst pressure point and bar-center point in pressure difference curve is geometry character value, the relation between pressure character index and injection parameter and engine torque is analyzed by means of measurement data, its result indicated that pressure character index is mapping to injection fuel parameter and engine torque one by one, Nitric Oxide (NOx) feedback model with cylinder pressure parameter based on Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural networks is founder, its training time and prediction precision are analyzed, NOx feedback model result by RBF neural networks is compared with that of BP neural networks. Test result is shown that establishing feedback model can meet the requirement of diesel engine.

articleTitle: A Shadowing Loss Compensation Method for Hybrid RSS-Based Indoor Localization
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Received signal strength (RSS) based localization schemes can be categorized as device-based localization (DBL) and device-free localization (DFL) in terms of the target to be located. DBL transforms RSS measurements of anchor-tag links to ranges and then obtains the target's position through trilateration. DFL infers an attenuation image from the target's body shadowing and regards the position with maximum attenuation as estimation. Existing hybrid method combining these two methods is able to improve the localization performance. However, the impact of the target's body shadowing loss on the anchor-tag links is not taken into consideration, worsening the localization accuracy of the DBL and hybrid method. In this paper, a new method is proposed to compensate the body shadowing loss by the exponential model on the basis of DFL result and the target's orientation. Experimental results validate that the compensation is beneficial and the proposed localization method is more reliable. Localization accuracy of the modified DBL is improved by 20% compared with the conventional DBL and the proposed hybrid localization method is 10% better than the conventional hybrid method.

articleTitle: Self-Tuning Filter for the System with Unknown Colored Noise
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a kind of self-tuning filter in the colored noise environment when the noise variance is unknown. The main method of this filter is whitening the colored noise, and the correlation function is used to get the estimations of the variance of the noise. An example for the target tracking system is presented to design the self-tuning filter for the position and velocity, the simulating results show the good convergence to the corresponding optimal filter.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Weighted HOSVD Denoising Method
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed an adaptive weighted HOSVD denoising method. Compared to traditional HOSVD algorithm, the proposed method adopts an adaptive weighted aggregation to reconstruct the denoised image. In addition, since HOSVD can be decomposed as a two-step procedure, we analyzed different weighted methods in each step and their combinations for total procedure. Finally, for different noise levels, we give the most suitable weighted choices. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method is superior to original HOSVD algorithm in most cases on both objective and subjective aspects.

articleTitle: On Optimization Algorithm of SAMP Step Size Based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The Sparsity Adaptive Matching Pursuit (SAMP) algorithm needs not to know a priori information of sparsity, which makes it has unique advantages compared to other greedy algorithms. In the reconstruction process, the step size can be changed with stage, which increases its reconstruction accuracy. Aiming at the step size of SAMP, it is unreasonable, will only increase and it is not decrease properly. If the result of one iteration is poor, it will continue on the larger step. This reduces the reconstruction quality of the algorithm. This paper designs a step which can be appropriately reduced, and proposes SAMP Optimized Variable Step reconstruction algorithm based on compressed sensing. The simulation results show that the improved algorithm can improve the reconstruction precision compared with the original algorithm, and has high accurate reconstruction probability, and reduces the reconstruction time by 20%.

articleTitle: Power Purchase Model Based on Interruptible Load Management and Balancing Market Forecast
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Interruptible load management is an important part of demand side management in the power market. Interruptible load management by the power companies and users will be interrupted to sign the contract. The implementation of the interrupt load management needs to solve the problem of determining the outage load contract model, which can interrupt load pricing, and participate in the market operation. Appropriate interruptible contracts, on the one hand, the users believe that the implementation of interruptible contracts for their own benefit, and in accordance with the requirements of the cut or the system peak load shifting. On the other hand, further gains can reduce or postpone the peaking capacity building. In this paper, we consider the combination of market equilibrium and interruptible load, and using the simulation software to get the minimum purchase cost, then the feasibility of the method is verified. The purpose of this method is to obtain the optimal scheme of load purchase, and to achieve the effect of peak clipping and valley filling, so that the power system can achieve optimal operation state.

articleTitle: Formal Definition of Program Faults and Hierarchy of Program Fault-Tolerant Abilities
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: These two issues are addressed in this paper: 1) the formal definitions of the concepts relevant to program faults, and 2) the comparison and classification of program faulttolerant abilities. We firstly analyze the subtle differences among these basic concepts: faults, errors and failures, and represent their formal definitions by using the state-based theory of program behavior; and then we propose a hierarchy for software fault-tolerant abilities from the aspect of satisfaction of safety and liveness properties. The main purpose of this work is to facilitate an accurate understanding of basic concepts and classifying of fault-tolerant abilities of different approaches in a systematic way.

articleTitle: Numerical Study on LNG Carrier Releasing Underwater and Emergency Treatments
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper is concerned about building up a model to simulate the LNG carrier releasing underwater process and assess the influence of emergency treatments. As a result, a model is proposed for simulating the process of LNG releasing underwater. It included releasing rate, spreading on water, heat & mass transferring and vapor cloud dispersion. Calculations have been performed whereby the releasing rate, liquid pool radius and vapor cloud size of LNG releasing underwater with explosive boiling triggering by thermodynamics instability, which have been compared to without explosive boiling in the releasing process, respectively, under the same initial conditions. The results suggest that treating LNG releasing underwater with explosive boiling triggering by thermodynamics instability results in overestimation of the pool during time of the order of ~10% and the flammable cloud size of order of ~5%. Furthermore, the model is also used to examine the influence of emergency treatments on the LNG releasing process. A comparison with the results generated by starting ejection system, spreading foam on liquid poo and spraying water mist into vapor cloud shows that the former two respectively play a major role on LNG releasing and spreading on water, and the last one can be considered as the most effective means to reduce dense gas dispersion scope and flammable cloud size.
